species.name: 1 Shuunen ★ USApyon
species.flavor: USApyon is handing out balloons for Yo-kai Watch World's 1st Anniversary party. He even modified his ray gun for the occasion and is helping with the lighting.

species.name: 1 Shuunen ★ Whisper
species.flavor: Whisper is brainstorming ideas for the first anniversary party. It seems he plans to make a surprise entrance by popping out of a special, oversized kusudama prepared for the occasion.

species.name: Acala Exalted
species.flavor: Lord Acala has awakened to his ultimate power through the deep bond between humans and Yo-kai. By accumulating experience alongside the master of the Stormweaver, he was able to attain this final form.

species.name: Afronaut
species.flavor: This Yo-kai's dream of exploring space is being ruined by his inability to fit his magnificent afro within a helmet.

species.name: Ageageha Shou En
species.flavor: A butterfly Yo-kai with wings so beautiful they seem otherworldly. Anyone who inhales his wing powder will make them feel incredibly uplifted.

species.name: Agent Spect-hare
species.flavor: This master uses her natural beauty and smarts to dig up all sorts of information. Nothing gets by those cute ears!

species.name: Agent X
species.flavor: The dapper suit serves as camouflage for this man of mystery. Nobody seems to know anything about him, and those that try to look into his history have a bad habit of vanishing into thin air.

species.name: Aka Oni Ryo Fu
species.flavor: Gargaros, the symbol of terror who descended from the Terror Time. His power is so immense that he obliterates weak Yo-kai.

species.name: Akiko
species.flavor: A member of the Doggy Special Task Force, she has a peppy habit of saying "Daemon", verbal tick or not. Even in the midst of battle, she has a lively smile and a hint of composure.

species.name: Allnyta
species.flavor: The bags under his eyes from playing video games all night are enough to make anyone worry for this Yo-kai's health.

species.name: Almi
species.flavor: When Almi Inspirits you, you'll want to treat others all the time. Your wallet will be empty before you know it.

species.name: Amanojaku Kan Gen
species.flavor: If you are inspirited by Contrarioni, you'll turn into a stubborn person who can't accept anything honestly.

species.name: Amaokami
species.flavor: The ocean's beauty caught Alpina's attention, reincarnating as an ama. After diving into the ocean, growing coral, and heading back to shore, she picks up flotsam and protects the life of the ocean.

species.name: Amefurashi Sai Bou
species.flavor: He keeps puffing out rain clouds and making it rain here and there, thoroughly drenching everything until it's completely soggy.

species.name: Amplifly
species.flavor: Those Inspirited by this excessively gaudy Yo-kai go over the top and exaggerate everything they do.

species.name: Aniki Gi En
species.flavor: A legendary Yo-kai said to have single-handedly annihilated an entire gang of delinquent Yo-kai. He is revered by many underlings as their big brother.

species.name: Ao Oni Ryo Fu
species.flavor: He continues to wander through the Terror Time, mercilessly swinging his iron club. He will only befriend someone that possesses the true strength of heart needed to overcome the Terror Time.

species.name: Apelican Ba Tou
species.flavor: A cheerful pelican Yo-kai who studied in Texas and became infatuated with American culture. He knows a lot about America, but can't speak English at all.

species.name: Appak
species.flavor: Appak can cut just about anything with his water sword. He wanders the world in order to heighten his skills

species.name: Arachnevil
species.flavor: This Yo-kai is a direct descendent of an oni clan. He is one of the few Yo-kai who can sacrifice his own life force to raise his power.

species.name: Arachnia
species.flavor: A poison specialist. He is a guy who likes very girly plans, like putting poison in cakes or kissing people while having poison lipstick on.

species.name: Armsman
species.flavor: Even headless he gives 110 percent. He dreams of reuniting with his head someday... Not sure how he dreams-- he just does.

species.name: Atsugaruru Kouho Suu
species.flavor: A Yo-kai with a hot heart and body. Just having Swelterrier nearby makes it so hot that you won't even need a heater.

species.name: Auntie Heart
species.flavor: Regardless of how bad a Yo-kai is, Auntie Heart's healing hug will make it pure again. That is some true kindness!

species.name: Ayamaridaoshi Toku Yuu
species.flavor: A Yo-kai that resembles a giant domino. No matter how small the mistake, he keeps blowing it out of proportion and piling on the blame until he crushes both his victim's body and spirit.

species.name: Azukiarai
species.flavor: As his name suggests, he is a Yo-kai that just keeps washing azuki beans. He is trying to catch up other people up with how cool it is to wash the beans, but even if other people saw it, they wouldn't be able to tell the difference between it and regular beans.

species.name: Azure Dragon
species.flavor: A legendary divine beast. {{tt|It|Yo-kai Watch

species.name: Babang Kou Getsuei
species.flavor: She blasts embarrassing secrets all over town through her giant speakers. Anyone whose secrets are exposed won't be able to live it down.

species.name: Babblong
species.flavor: Don't agree to listen to Babblong or else he'll talk and talk and talk and talk and talk and talk. He's a terrible listener.

species.name: Baddinyan
species.flavor: Jibanyan gone bad. REAL BAD. With an impressive pompadour haircut and classy tails, he's a delinquent with no cause.

species.name: Badude
species.flavor: This gang leader runs into enemy territory wielding his brutal nail bat. That's his way of taking care of his gang.

species.name: BaiKING
species.flavor: The king of bacteria, he stands at the top of all bacteria in the world. He once ran rampant in the seas, but was chased out because of his smell, and now he lives alone in ruins, cultivating various bacteria.

species.name: Bake-arare Sai Bou
species.flavor: A Yo-kai with powerful ice powers even when it's alone. If you are hit by his freezing air or ice crystals, the part they hit will freeze solid.

species.name: Baku Ri Shi
species.flavor: A Yo-kai that makes the「dreams」people are seeing her food. She puts the person she inspirits to sleep and slowly enjoys feasting on the dream they are having.

species.name: Bakuon-narashi Kan Chuu
species.flavor: In pursuit of the ultimate deafening roar, he ended up riding off on a stolen motorcycle. Those annoying people who make a racket on the streets might be inspirited by Rawry.

species.name: Bakusoku Taishi Ji
species.flavor: He clings to your feet and runs around town. He races at incredible speed and can't stop even at dead ends. If he clings to you before a race, victory is practically guaranteed.

species.name: Bananose
species.flavor: This Yo-kai is made of banana and is often bothered by circling flies. No relation to Babblong.

species.name: Banchou
species.flavor: A Banchō Yo-kai, who appears when the weak are being bullied, punishes the bullies and sends them to hell. He is an encouraging ally to good children, but shows no mercy to bad guys.

species.name: Bay Kappa
species.flavor: Mitsumatagi transforms into this Ancient Yo-kai Hero by merging with Faux Kappa, and uses a giant boomerang as a weapon to launch innovative attacks.

species.name: BBQvil
species.flavor: This Yo-kai firmly believes that there's nothing better than a barbecue—one with plenty of meat!

species.name: Beelzebold
species.flavor: Timidevil at full power! He still gets nervous every so often, though.

species.name: Benkei Ten I
species.flavor: He hides 999 swords, stolen from his defeated opponents, in his stomach. When necessary, the swords shoot out and impale his enemies.

species.name: Benzaiten
species.flavor: One of the Seven Gods of Fortune. She's trying to master the electric guitar to bring fortune with a fresh brand of hard rock.

species.name: Bikyaku Shin Kenei
species.flavor: A swift messenger Yo-kai with beautifully shaped legs that gives anyone it inspirits incredibly gorgeous legs. If it inspirits a man, he ends up with needlessly beautiful legs, making for a rather pitiful sight.

species.name: Bishamonten
species.flavor: One of the Seven Gods of Fortune. A patron of warriors, he is said to ward off disasters and evil with his fierce scowl.

species.name: Bison Burly
species.flavor: Burly, finally given the promotion he so richly deserves. He's still a fired up guy who dashes out onto the front lines.

species.name: Blips
species.flavor: If you see someone get out of a pool with blue lips, they might just be inspirited by Blips...

species.name: Blobgoblin
species.flavor: Legend has it that this Yo-kai feeds off dead humans to nourish their flesh. If they like you, they will tear their flesh, said to help grant eternal youth, to pieces and give it to you.

species.name: Blowkade
species.flavor: Blowkade is one weird Yo-kai. Nobody knows why he puts his all into blocking people's paths.

species.name: Boobou Tou Ken
species.flavor: He's usually spaced out, but when he's spotted, he runs away at an astonishing speed. He can run 100 meters in under 8 seconds.

species.name: Boogiemum
species.flavor: A Yo-kai born from the gathered feelings of shy people that dream of a gorgeous world! Let’s dance our self-taught, unique dance with our friends, every night!

species.name: Boyclops
species.flavor: Not the most intimidating of Yo-kai, but he saves so much on contact lenses that he doesn't really care.

species.name: Brokenbrella
species.flavor: A Yo-kai born from the pain of a flimsy plastic umbrella who desperately wished he was a sturdier model.

species.name: Brushido
species.flavor: A foot soldier who loves cleaning. His spotless reputation means he's sure to be a shogun someday.

species.name: Buchinyan
species.flavor: A combination of Jibanyan and Whisper. Despite their obvious differences, it actually works pretty well.

species.name: Budounyan Chou Un
species.flavor: A cat Yo-kai made from 100% grape juice. He bewitches girls with the sweet aroma he gives off from his body. He even claims to be the most popular guy in the entire fruit industry.

species.name: Buhu
species.flavor: This bird Yo-kai is always bummed out. People it Inspirits get depressed and distracted a lot.

species.name: Bukakkou Chou Han
species.flavor: If you become possessed by this guy, even the most proper and well-mannered person will end up looking awkward and unfashionable. He's worried about it and is feeling down about it.

species.name: Bunbundori Jo Ei
species.flavor: He uses his perfect lassoing skills to snatch things from others. He has a legendary story of using a rope to retrieve his ex-girlfriend from a wedding.

species.name: Bunny Chocomint
species.flavor: Agent Spect-hare hands out Valentine's chocolate for her mission. She is like a cool chocolate mint, tricking the target with sweet differences and smartly obtains information from them.

species.name: Bushinyan Future
species.flavor: ”Bushinyan conformed to modern high-technology and reincarnated. Belonging to special forces called SNYAT, he protects everyone's safety with his armor-style bulletproof vest and proud sword.

species.name: Bushou Hi no Shin
species.flavor: A godlike Yo-kai with unparalleled creativity who can instantly materialize any thing that comes to mind. He has so many things he wants to do that his two arms aren't enough, so he grown six arms to keep up with his activities.

species.name: Buttered Blue
species.flavor: A boxer who always gets beaten black and blue. He's nice and chewy, but that won't help him in the ring.

species.name: Cadable
species.flavor: Cadin has trained his 'cicada ninjitsu' to its peak. Now Cadable claims it's a worthy martial art! *crickets* *cicadas*

species.name: Camellia
species.flavor: Born from a flower, this beautiful Yo-kai princess is loved by her subjects for her powers of healing.

species.name: Cap'n Rex
species.flavor: The last in a long line of legendary pirates. His motto ""Full steam ahead!" has sunk every ship he's sailed on, as well as his family legacy. He's known as Captain Shipwreck by sailors everywhere.

species.name: Carniboy
species.flavor: A red-blooded Yo-kai who uses a gorgeous tan, luscious golden locks, and robust supply of one- liners to wow the ladies.

species.name: Casanuva
species.flavor: This narcissist makes every lady he sees fall in love with him, regardless of appearance.

species.name: Castelius II
species.flavor: Castelius II will always lock you in second place. Not bad, but you could have done a bit better...?

species.name: Charlie
species.flavor: A bicycle that was thrown away by its owner gained a soul and transformed into a Yo-kai. When someone rides him, he gets so happy that he cheerfully speeds along even up hills. Rain doesn’t bother him at all.

species.name: Chatalie
species.flavor: All talk and no action. If she inspirits you, you'll be the same and lose the trust of others.

species.name: Cheeksqueek
species.flavor: A Yo-kai that can't stop farting. There's a rumor that it just has really bad breath... but I'm not going to clear the air here.

species.name: Chi Ma Tree
species.flavor: A giant tree in The Sea of Trees that became a Yo-kai by absorbing the hatred generated by humans. Whenever he finds a lost person, he plots to eat them, but they always escape.

species.name: Chikuchiku Uni Ryou Ka
species.flavor: Coughkoff looks almost exactly like him. Since they are often mistaken for each other, he regards Coughkoff as his sworn enemy. If he were by the water, he’d be Hurchin.

species.name: Chippa
species.flavor: An eternal optimist that never worries about anything. Being Inspirited by him can be worse that you think.

species.name: Chocobonyan
species.flavor: Jibanyan managed to become friends with a legendary Chocobo. They're ready for a fantastical adventure.

species.name: Chummer
species.flavor: Chummer loves eating kids. He'll make them loiter after school before devouring them. He likes asparagus too.

species.name: Compunzer
species.flavor: Even though he wants to make people laugh, Compunzer's jokes fall flat and just lead to awkward silences.

species.name: Cornfused
species.flavor: You won't understand anything when this guy's around, no matter how well it's explained.

species.name: Cue-Tee
species.flavor: Cue-Tee's cue cards make you do whatever is written on them! She might look shy, but her orders can be pretty harsh!

species.name: Cupistol
species.flavor: This debonair Yo-kai is quite a hit with the ladies. Anyone he shoots will love you. He's just the greatest! *swoon*

species.name: Cutta-nah
species.flavor: A lazy katana Yo-kai that can drain all of your motivation. He's strangely sharp for being so lazy.

species.name: Cutta-nah-nah
species.flavor: Too lazy to get a haircut, but not too lazy to slash enemies with his untidy strands.

species.name: Cynake
species.flavor: This sulky snake Yo-kai will make you sulk at the slightest problem. Hmph!

species.name: D-Stroy
species.flavor: T-Wrecks is all grown up and now uses his incredible strength to completely demolish things in his path.

species.name: D'wanna
species.flavor: D'wanna's chants will weaken your resolve! This can make you give up on... y'know, stuff and whatever.

species.name: Da Ji
species.flavor: A female fox Yo-kai who has lived for over a thousand years. Long ago, it is said that with her beauty and sweet, melting voice she bewitched the king of a nation called Yin, leading it to ruin. In fact, she likes cute things, and she can't help being kind to small animals.

species.name: Dai Haou Komasan Son Saku
species.flavor: Komasan, who became stronger with the help of "Little Overlord" Sun Ce, trained further to protect his friends and reached the peak of his "Great Overlord" power. I'm trying my best to let the hem of my fine cloak flutter so as not to step on it and fall.

species.name: Dai Maou Shibu
species.flavor: A Great Demon King who creates new and interesting things, captivating people with them. He loves the heroes who challenge him and always smiles even during battles. Incidentally, the floating games around him are some of the masterpieces he created himself such as「Romance of the Three Kingdoms.」

species.name: Dai Totoku Nurarihyon
species.flavor: Zazel has navigated through many battlefields and wields the right command as the governor. His military administration gives all Yo-kai a place to play an active role, leads the battle to victory, and brings more prosperity.

species.name: Daidarabotchi Seki Heki
species.flavor: A legendary giant Yo-kai that even appears in fairy tales. Some even say that, rather than being a Yo-kai, he is actually a god that created mountains and ponds.

species.name: Daija no Tsubo Hou Ki
species.flavor: It looks like an ordinary pot, but inside is a huge, snake. It is said that the jack-in-the-box was invented by someone who happened to see a pot with a snake inside.

species.name: Daikudan Kan Ro
species.flavor: After overcoming harsh training, he awakened her ability to see the future. He can foresee anything, but he will never use it for anything bad.

species.name: Daiz
species.flavor: Daiz just stares off into space, sometimes not moving for three whole days. What's he thinking about all that time...?

species.name: Dame Dedtime
species.flavor: Once a fair-faced young maiden, she spent most of her life behind bars for a crime she didn't commit. Now she robs humans of their happiness, just as she was robbed of hers.

species.name: Dame Dredful
species.flavor: A witch who has spent years studying black magic. Her spells are imbued with a lifetime of bitterness and are extra powerful as a result. In her spare time, she likes to morph into a tin can.

species.name: Damona
species.flavor: The princess of a small netherworld region. Her power is immense, but she lacks the power to feel any emotions.

species.name: Darudaruma Bun Shuu
species.flavor: At first glance, it looks like a daruma that seems to bring good luck, but inside is a Yo-kai with a weary-looking face. When someone is inspirited by this Yo-kai, their body becomes sluggish and lethargic.

species.name: Darumacho
species.flavor: Now a truly macho Yo-kai, this one worked tirelessly in a mountain retreat to train away his dullness.

species.name: Darumatcho Bun Shuu
species.flavor: Through training in the mountains, he overcame his laziness and became muscular. The scar on his forehead is actually body paint meant to show off his training.

species.name: Decidevible
species.flavor: This despot makes big decisions without any concern for others! He might work well with indecisive people.

species.name: Deep Shadow Galaxy
species.flavor: Mist Shadow's overdrive form. Its speed and power have been strengthened, and it overwhelms the enemies in front of it with its flawless movement and powerful attacks.

species.name: Deep Shadow Zodiac
species.flavor: Mist Shadow's overdrive form. With enhanced power and speed, he uses seamless movement and powerful attacks to destroy anyone who stands in his way.

species.name: Demandi
species.flavor: Uses her unbelievable cuteness to get others to listen to her impossible demands. Enjoys watching the resulting panic.

species.name: Demuncher
species.flavor: A terrifying Yo-kai who opens his huge mouth and swallows demons whole. Has very bad indigestion.

species.name: Denjin Ba Kin
species.flavor: A Yo-kai that governs radio waves, sometimes revered almost like a god. Thanks to the widespread use of smartphones, the value and appreciation of Signiton have apparently increased tremendously.

species.name: Denpaku-kozou Ba Kin
species.flavor: A mischievous Yo-kai that happily gobbles up the radio waves drifting through the air. Whenever it's around, cell phones stop getting a signal.

species.name: Devibiran Kaku Shi
species.flavor: Timidevil having shed his cowardly heart, has become the most powerful demon. However, he can still occasionally revert to his old self.

species.name: Devibiru Kaku Shi
species.flavor: An extremely timid demon. Always on edge and unable to unleash his true power. Some say he is invincible when he can relax.

species.name: Devourer
species.flavor: He sucks the energy out of his victims but leaves their bodies intact so that they look like they've simply fallen asleep.

species.name: DG Trooper
species.flavor: Dog-shaped soldiers, mostly used by Aliens. They are highly skilled fighters and use weapons such as batons. If they are in a group, they act in a controlled manner.

species.name: Dimmy
species.flavor: Being Inspirited by Dimmy will tone down your presence. Dimmy uses this for his job as a ninja.

species.name: Doggy Special Task Force
species.flavor: She is the leader of the Doggy Special Task Force and Doruru's sister. She is small in stature, but she has brains the size of a galaxy and brings together a team of unique personalities.

species.name: Dokeching Ka Ku
species.flavor: A greedy Yo-kai who schemes to make all the wealth in the world his own. He will stop at nothing to obtain money.

species.name: Dorobokkun Saku Yuu
species.flavor: Having developed a taste for never returning borrowed items, Yoink has now become an active thief. He snatches up what he steals and stores it in the furoshiki on his head.

species.name: Doruru
species.flavor: A member of the Inu Tokumeitai and sister of Poo, she is a very quiet person. She is good at fighting in teams with her sister, and is a skilled fighter who can move under the precise direction of Poo in both defense and attack.

species.name: Double Time
species.flavor: This Yo-kai lives at twice the speed of your run-of-the-mill spirit. The only time he slows down is to read his comic books.

species.name: Doukaku Doujakudai
species.flavor: Anyone inspirited by Castelius III will end up in third place no matter what they do. Those who are satisfied with Castelius III will never see a truly bright tomorrow.

species.name: Dr. Maddiman
species.flavor: This madman used to perform experiments on humans at his hospital. Even as a Yo-kai, his search for new test subjects continues…

species.name: Dr. Nocturne
species.flavor: This gifted doctor has a rather complicated relationship with his father, who is also a doctor of some renown.

species.name: Draaagin
species.flavor: A desperately indecisive dragon. Don't expect that anything at all will get done when he's around.

species.name: Dracunyan
species.flavor: Jibanyan has taken the form of a vampire, but his victims really don't need to worry—they'll feel a bit dizzy at worst.

species.name: Draggie
species.flavor: A dragon kid who wants attention. He can see the hidden strengths of others with the ball on his head.

species.name: Drenchetta
species.flavor: Being close to Drenchetta alone makes you damp. The sister of Dismarelda, pray you never have to face the two of them together!

species.name: Drizzle
species.flavor: Drizzle creates rain cloud wherever it goes. You can find it in places that are thoroughly wet.

species.name: Dromp
species.flavor: Fairy tales tell of the monstrous Dromp building mountains and digging ponds.

species.name: Droplette
species.flavor: Droplette makes his way to places that don't get much sun and makes them damp and moldy...Gross.

species.name: Dubbles
species.flavor: Dubbles will inspirit you and point you toward an unknown fate. Even he doesn't know if it'll be a good or bad one.

species.name: Dulluma
species.flavor: He looks like a lucky daruma, but his real body is inside the shell. Dull and sluggish, he can really slow you down.

species.name: Dummkap
species.flavor: This hat Yo-kai can make geniuses into dreamy fools. A foolish life can be more fun...but would you even realize if it were?!

species.name: Earthman
species.flavor: This is the form that the Heroes have assimilated through the "Fusion Combination," a forbidden technique in the Yokai World. His bravery and fearlessness make him the "legendary giant of light".

species.name: Elder Bloom
species.flavor: This legendary Hungramps supposedly once filled a city with spirit-invigorating cherry blossoms.

species.name: Ema
species.flavor: Neighfarious was accidentally enshrined because his name sounds similar to "ema". He was already a rare creature, but now that he's been deemed sacred, the mystery surrounding him only deepens.

species.name: Emenyan
species.flavor: A Yo-kai made of emerald. If you could sell him, he'd be worth more than 100 million dollars.

species.name: Enefly
species.flavor: A butterfly Yo-kai who makes those it Inspirits cut ties with their best friends. Often mistaken for Enerfly.

species.name: Enerfly
species.flavor: A butterfly Yo-kai who brings those it inspirits to their peak condition. Often mistaken for Enefly.

species.name: Enraenra Shin Shi
species.flavor: A smoke Yo-kai that wanders the air, constantly changing shape. Being made of smog, she can take on any form, but her current form, which has received the most positive feedback, is her favorite.

species.name: Espy
species.flavor: Espy gets a kick out of reading people's minds. It's totally not fair that no one can read hers... and now she knows that too.

species.name: Eyellure
species.flavor: The eyes that cover his body are made of jewels and give off a light so bright that he sometimes blinds even himself.

species.name: Faysoff
species.flavor: This most classic of Classic Yo-kai can give anyone he Inspirits a completely blank expression.

species.name: Fishpicable
species.flavor: Fishpicable sees only the bad in people and slaps things he hates with his tail. His tail is very busy.

species.name: Flippa
species.flavor: Dame Dredful's opening act Yo-kai. Floppa is her partner that she met as a first-year student at the witch training school, and she is not her real sister. Her harmonious combination magic is now in the realm of mastery. The name of her combination with Floppa is "Flippa and Floppa".

species.name: Flippit
species.flavor: Appears besides those fast asleep and flips over their pillows. If you've ever had a restless night, he's probably paid you a visit.

species.name: Flumpy
species.flavor: Flumpy can make even the coolest person unfashionable and awkward. He hates being so unstylish.

species.name: Foiletta
species.flavor: Toiletta's now in high school, where her love of curses and disruptive behavior has earned her a new nickname.

species.name: Fuji no Yama Chou Kou
species.flavor: A Yo-kai from a snowy region who loves sumo wrestling. With legs and hips honed on the ice, he displays astonishing tenacity in any situation.

species.name: Fujimi Gozen Suu Shi
species.flavor: A Yo-kai who has achieved immortality. She can no longer die and does not age. Her power seems to lie in her staff, so if the staff is taken away, she ages instantly.

species.name: Fukai Ko Hou
species.flavor: One of the Wicked Executives. She loves unpleasant emotions and try to share that unpleasantness with others. She is the most beautiful among all the Wicked.

species.name: Fukuro-jijii Hi I
species.flavor: A Yo-kai that delivers and distributes presents to souls. Since all of the gifts come through Santa Claus and are nothing but wonderful presents, you can accept them without worry.

species.name: Fukurou
species.flavor: One of those who serve Shutendoji, who fires blow darts that are coated in yōdoku. This draws out a disturbing aura, making one forget oneself and turn violent.

species.name: Fukuryuu Ryuu Zen
species.flavor: A dragon that brings happiness, with a flower of happiness blooming on his head. His power to bring good fortune is famous and there are apparently shrines dedicated to Bloominoko.

species.name: Fusafusan Hou Tou
species.flavor: A Yo-kai that makes everything grow thick and fluffy. If something is furry in a place where it shouldn't be, it's probably this Yo-kai's doing.

species.name: Fuu 2
species.flavor: Average kid Nathan Adams suffered an average death and is now an average Yo-kai! He makes all whom he inspirits... average!

species.name: Fuu-kun
species.flavor: A mischievous and unpredictable wind Yo-kai who works alongside his partner, Rai-chan, as Lord Ananta's capable right-hand man. He is a mischievous and curious little guy who is always looking for someone to play with.

species.name: Fuumazaru Ba Chou
species.flavor: A monkey Yo-kai possessing the power of the Fuma clan. Before becoming a Yo-kai, he was apparently a legendary ninja. Even now, he steals treasures silently, like the wind.

species.name: Fuumin Chou Sen
species.flavor: The power of Diao-Cicada, one of the four most beautiful women in China, resides in Insomni, a Yo-kai who does not let you sleep. Insomni seems to be satisfied with her gorgeous outfits and decorations.

species.name: Gabunyan Chou Un
species.flavor: A cat Yo-kai that became Dracula-like taking in the blood of a Western Yo-kai. His ability to suck blood is not very strong, and even if you get bitten, at most you'll only become anemic.

species.name: Gaki Kan Gen
species.flavor: A Yo-kai that throws childish fits and bothers everyone around him, even though he's already grown up. Be careful not to end up acting like Tantroni.

species.name: Gakkouger Enma
species.flavor: A giant robot created by Shunsuke Enmadai. Boasting overwhelming strength, its fights gigantic enemies with the Daiemma Blade as its weapon.

species.name: Gakkouger Y
species.flavor: A giant robot docked in the Y Academy building. A hidden function designed to protect the students when the school is under threat.

species.name: Gamanmosu Kou Gai
species.flavor: As a result of continuing to hold in his pee, he developed the ultimate endurance, allowing him to endure just about anything. Why he kept holding it in for that long, however, remains a mystery.

species.name: Gariouji Kouho Suu
species.flavor: An ice wolf believed to be the guardian deity of the snowy mountains. Many legends tell of people who became lost in the mountains and were rescued by him.

species.name: Geki Dragon Sou Shin
species.flavor: A Yo-kai that explodes with such furious rage that it can shake the earth. When inspirited by a Firewig, one loses control of oneself in rage, to the point where all the dishes in the house break.

species.name: Gikkuri-otoko Gaku Shin
species.flavor: A fearsome Yo-kai that wreaks havoc on people's lower backs, leaving them with a sudden, crippling back strain. Older people are more susceptible to being inspirited by him.

species.name: Gilgaros
species.flavor: The strongest oni ever born. His power is so great that it needs no explanation. None. At all. Even this is too much...

species.name: Gimme
species.flavor: Why borrow people's stuff when you can just steal it? Stores his loot in the bag on his head.

species.name: Ginkaku Doujakudai
species.flavor: Anyone possessed by Castelius II will end up in second place no matter what they do. It might not seem so bad, but it's not good to be satisfied with this, you'll never become the very best

species.name: Gishinanki Kan Gen
species.flavor: An oni who can't be satisfied unless he questions everything. He always travels together with his fellow oni, but he doesn't trust them in the slightest.

species.name: Glitzy Bones
species.flavor: Gutsy Bones got himself covered in diamonds, but he's more interested in seeing what comes out of the Crank-a-kai next than in the fact that he's now the most valuable Yo-kai in the world!

species.name: Gnomine
species.flavor: Gnomey turned Wicked! He brings repeated bad fortune to a home, eventually ruining its owners.

species.name: Goku Orochi Shuu Yu
species.flavor: Goku Orochi imbued with the power of Zhou Yu, a handsome military commander with wisdom and bravery. Goku Orochi's ruthless assassination techniques have been honed to their limits by Zhou Yu's talent.

species.name: Gokudou Gi En
species.flavor: Wielding his trusty「nail bat,」this assault squad captain Yo-kai charges headlong into battle. Despite appearances, he takes good care of his juniors.

species.name: Golden Dai Kenshi Kyuubi Jun Iku
Goridaruma Bun Shuu
species.flavor: As a result of striving for even greater heights, Darumacho gained the physique and strength of a gorilla. He can crush cars like marshmallows.

species.name: Goromi
species.flavor: A sharp-eyed cat Yo-kai with her favorite cork gun. She claims to be a Yo-kai that is one rank higher than an Onryo, and she clings to Jinpei.

species.name: Got It Maid
species.flavor: An expert maid who can complete any task she is set. She never takes it easy on her students though.

species.name: Goukai To Yo
species.flavor: One of the Wicked Executives. A Yo-kai who insists that everything be done in an extravagant manner. He possesses the greatest raw power among the Wicked.

species.name: Grainpa
species.flavor: A rare Hungramps with a body made of rice. He's so kind, he'll let a hungry person eat part of his body if necessary.

species.name: Grey Agent
species.flavor: Aliens with big black eyes that glow suspiciously and control mysterious powers; they are famous among space enthusiasts, with many recorded UFO sightings.

species.name: Grubsnitch
species.flavor: If you can't stop snacking before dinner, Grubsnitch is probably nearby.

species.name: Grumples
species.flavor: Bitter towards youth and beauty, Grumples makes people wrinkly. She was quite the beauty when she was young, though.

species.name: Guraguraion Chou Hi
species.flavor: With his strong legs stomping alternately, he shake the earth violently. It is said that the vibrations caused by Quaken have the power to move even the most stubborn hearts.

species.name: Gurerurin Gi En
species.flavor: A troublesome Yo-kai whose reason for living is to act like a rebellious tough guy. He possesses serious people and drags them into the world of evil.

species.name: Gush
species.flavor: If it Inspirits you, your nose won't stop bleeding. This Yo-kai can be much scarier than it looks.

species.name: Gusto
species.flavor: A cat that became a Yo-kai while it was still alive, due to having led a very long life. He's recognizable by his long ears and fluffy fur, and his nose works surprisingly well. His hobby and specialty is 'returning'.

species.name: Gyakujouo Ri Kaku
species.flavor: This is a nasty Yo-kai that, no matter how wrong it is, will lash out and rampage when scolded. Those who lash out when scolded might be inspirited?

species.name: Gyuuki
species.flavor: An atrocious Yo-kai who was born from the revengeful ghosts of a rampaging cow and a poisonous spider. With its severe poison from its claws and horns, it slowly but steadily torments its human prey and then devours them.

species.name: Hack King
species.flavor: Indexter has fallen off the grid and become the King of Hackers! Now no electronic device is safe!

species.name: Hakai Bun Ou
species.flavor: One of the Wicked Executives. He is the leader of the Wicked and lives by the motto of destroying everything. His combat power is the number one among the Wicked.

species.name: Hakuja Kaira
species.flavor: Ananta jumps into the world of the Three Kingdoms as a military commander. He races through the battlefield as a military commander and fights bravely at the vanguard. On various battlefields, he continues to hone his martial prowess.

species.name: Hanahojin Chin Kyuu
species.flavor: Snottle doesn't need a reason to pick his nose. He has two nostrils. Whatever's in them, he just wants to dig it out. That's all there is to it.

species.name: Hanako-san Sai En
species.flavor: Hanako-san, who researches how to scare people in the times. She has the power of Ei, who has excellent literary talent, is enthusiastic about research, and has left many works.

species.name: Happi USApyon Chuutatsu
species.flavor: USApyon enlivens the festival by wearing a happi coat imbued with the power of Zhongda. With the dream of traveling through space someday in mind, the festival drums sound towards the sky.

species.name: Harao-dori Jo Ei
species.flavor: A somewhat strange Yo-kai with a pattern on his stomach that looks just like an old man’s face, he is particularly skilled at belly dancing, using the pattern as part of his performance.

species.name: Harawashell Chou Seihei
species.flavor: If you get inspirited by him, you'll start paying for everything without hesitation. Before you know it, your wallet will be completely empty.

species.name: Hare-onna
species.flavor: A weather Yo-kai who brings about the blue sky with her sparkling, beautiful smile. She's can be a bit of a crybaby and a moody person at times. Her parents are the famous weather Yo-kai, Ray O'Light and Drizzelda.

species.name: Hare-otoko Shiba Shou
species.flavor: Wherever Ray O'Light is, it never rains. He's always cheerful and energetic. He's currently making an strong effort to brighten the heart of Drizzelda.

species.name: Hatsudenshin Ba Kin
species.flavor: He is usually lazy, but it is said that if he were to get serious, he could solve every energy-related problem imaginable. A god of the world of energy.

species.name: Headasteam
species.flavor: He's been at the controls so long, he's become one with the Hexpress' engine room. He eats coal to keep the train running, but he overheats a little too easily. Where will this runaway train stop?

species.name: Heheheel
species.flavor: This eel just can't stop laughing, and nobody knows why. Maybe its sense of humor is broken.

species.name: Hekokijin You Hou
species.flavor: A Yo-kai that farts incredibly badly. If you ever find trapped in an enclosed space with Cuttincheez, you'd better prepare for the worst.

species.name: Hi no Shin
species.flavor: A God-like Yo-kai, who uses overflowing imagination power and his 6 arms to manage ideas and continues to incessantly create.

species.name: High Gnomey
species.flavor: It's said that if you get hold of a single hair from this deity Yo-kai's head, you'll enjoy an eternity of good fortune.

species.name: Higurashimaru U Kin
species.flavor: A practitioner of the Cicada Ninjutsu who fights while singing in a beautiful voice. Yo-kai who use this ninjutsu are extremely rare, to the point that their battles attract spectators.

species.name: Hikikoumori So Ju
species.flavor: If you're possessed by Hidabat, you'll become afraid to go outside and end up reclusing. People nowadays are especially prone to being inspirited by Hidabat, so be careful.

species.name: Hinozall Awoken
species.flavor: Hinozall's "Awoken" form, in which his capacity for ideas expands beyond the limits of his brain. In fact, the earth can no longer hold all of his ideas, so he seeks to create a new planet.

species.name: Hiraishin Rai Dou
species.flavor: A Yo-kai that gathers lightning and controls it at will. No matter how troublesome the problem, he takes it on like a lightning rod. Lately, it seems to be taking on too much and is starting to get stiff shoulders.

species.name: Hissfit
species.flavor: This foul-tempered little fellow stamps his feet constantly, making it hard to take him seriously.

species.name: Hitomakasennin Sa Ji
species.flavor: A Yo-kai who leaves absolutely everything to other people. He employs dozens of disciples and leaves everything up to them. He even leaves fighting to someone else.

species.name: Hitotsume-kozou Ou Rou
species.flavor: A mostly harmless Yo-kai with no special powers, so much so that people would be surprised if he appeared. The only thing he enjoys is that he only needs half as many contact lenses as everyone else.

species.name: Hitsugiban Kirisaki Joker
species.flavor: He is the younger brother of two prison guard brothers who terrorize prisoners with his large scythe and bizarre behavior. As he carries out sentences, he gives prisoners mushroom haircuts and is notorious for the eerie grin he wears while doing so.

species.name: Hoggles
species.flavor: Hoggles used to be a little piglet of a guy until he drank a broth made of other Yo-kai, then he got huge!

species.name: Hojiro Sameki
species.flavor: One of Mazera's direct soldiers. With a sharp beam sword that can also be used as a beam gun, he can change his fighting style according to the situation during a fight.

species.name: Homura Tengu Ba Shoku
species.flavor: Tengu with fiery red hair. It is said that when the world is in turmoil, he causes droughts and withers the land, warning people against their actions.

species.name: Honebijin Bi Shi
species.flavor: She boasts that no one can match the beauty of her bones. So confident is she in her skeleton that she decided to live with her bones completely exposed for all to see.

species.name: Horizontail
species.flavor: This Yo-kai quickly gets tired and fed up of doing anything. He'd rather just kick back and lounge around on his tail.

species.name: Horyuu Ryuu Hyou
species.flavor: A dragon Yo-kai that can't make decisions right away and always puts things on hold. When you get inspirited by him,「Let's put it on hold for now!」will become your catchphrase.

species.name: Hot Pot
species.flavor: A heart came to dwell inside of a pot that was used at a ramen shop for many years turning it into a yokai. In order to fill both the heart and the pot, which were left empty after the shop closed down, a body that is quite full was created.

species.name: Houroushi Tei Iku
species.flavor: He travels from place to place on a wandering journey. It is said to be a miracle when the three elder brothers, Illoo, Elloo, and Alloo, gather together.

species.name: Hu Ximei
species.flavor: She is a pheasant Yo-kai and the younger companion of Da Ji. She is a bright and energetic girl, but she has a selfish personality that wants to do whatever she wants. Because Wang Guiren, who is always with her, doesn’t listen to what she says, they often end up arguing.

species.name: Hungorge
species.flavor: A terribly gluttonous Yo-kai that'll eat anything in front of him. His mouth is like a black hole-- even rice can't escape it.

species.name: Hungramps
species.flavor: A Yo-kai who is always hungry and can make other tummies rumble... That's really about the only thing he can do.

species.name: Hurchin
species.flavor: He looks just like Coughkoff, but don't say that! He hates that guy.

species.name: Huskian
species.flavor: A cool dog woman with a beautiful face, and a member of the Doggy Special Task Force, she is confident in her speed and has the ability to attack and counterattack with a unstoppable amount of speed. She is confident in her sprinting and whizzes around, attacking quickly, leaving no room for a counterattack. Did we mention she is fast?

species.name: Hyouhenna Son Ken
species.flavor: At first glance, she looks like a Reversa, but it's actually a rare Yo-kai whose pattern colors are slightly different. It seems to stay depressed longer than a Reversa.

species.name: Hyouhennu Son Ken
species.flavor: One moment he's all smiles, the next he's suddenly depressed over something trivial, causing trouble for everyone. In a way, he's even more troublesome than Dismarelda.

species.name: Ichigonyan Chou Un
species.flavor: A cat Yo-kai made of 100% strawberry juice. His greatest pride is being able to sit atop a shortcake, the highest honor in the strawberry industry.

species.name: Ikemenken Kaku Kyohei
species.flavor: By some mistake, the legendary human-faced dog has become incredibly handsome. His handsome smile will bring you comfort.

species.name: Ikkaku Sou Hi
species.flavor: A sacred Yo-kai distinguished by his single beautiful horn. It is said that various powerful figures throughout history have used every means possible to acquire that horn.

species.name: Illoo
species.flavor: A caring teacher who uses illusions to simplify his lessons. He can make complex topics seem pretty accessible.

species.name: Impass
species.flavor: You...you just can't get by Impass. Why?! What's his motivation?! What's the story behind him?! Nobody knows...

species.name: Infinipea
species.flavor: He's spent several hundred years spinning and spinning and spinning and...history has kind of passed him by. Civilizations rise and fall, technology marches on, and Infinipea spins. But lately, he's into meeting new people.

species.name: Injurnalist
species.flavor: An intrepid reporter who rushes to the scene when someone's in pain, and is quick to pen a lurid story.

species.name: Inugami Jun Iku
species.flavor: A nine-tailed dog spirit said to be even rarer than the nine-tailed fox. He has beautiful, silver fur, and it is said that if you have even a single strand of that fur, you will be guaranteed good fortune for generations to come.

species.name: Irewig
species.flavor: This bug makes people get grumpy—and asking them what's wrong will only make things worse!

species.name: Isshougomen
species.flavor: He's been apologizing for a while, but he finally couldn't take it anymore, and decided to reincarnate. He apologizes for his very sincere apologies, but he, strangely, doesn't really feel that bad about it.

species.name: Izanami Son Shoukou
species.flavor: A god-like Yo-kai who serves as the source of all life. As proof of this, she herself claims that most of the nearby gods were born from her.

species.name: Jakou Kenshin Jyoka
species.flavor: The arrogant evil god, Nüwa, whose anger has reached its peak, unleashes her power. Wielding a sword imbued with the divine power said to have created humanity, she annihilates anyone who stands in her way. She will not stop until the world is plunged into terror.

species.name: Janegabuun Sou Hyou
species.flavor: An evil Yo-kai that plunges the hearts of those he possesses into the depths of despair. Unless he disappear, it's impossible to recover on your own. Such a dangerous Yo-kai.

species.name: Jetnyan Chou Un
species.flavor: Jibanyan dreams of racing through the vast sky. However, even if he puts a model airplane on his head, there's no way he can fly, and it seems he's recently hit a dead end.

species.name: Jibanyan
species.flavor: After being run over by a truck, he inspirits an intersection and seeks to get his revenge on passing trucks.

species.name: Jibanyan
species.flavor: A Jibakurei Cat Yo-kai. He is someone who was once in contact with many humans, and was even recognized in the Yo-kai World. Ever since he parted with his favorite human, he has become a wandering Yo-kai.

species.name: Jibanyan S
species.flavor: Finally Jibanyan is S-Rank! He's stronger and confident that he'll beat the truck, but...

species.name: Jibanyan S Ryuu Bi
species.flavor: Jibanyan has finally made his S-Rank debut. He seems brimming with confidence, believing the time has come to triumph over the truck, now reborn and stronger than ever...

species.name: Jibanyan-senchou
species.flavor: Captain Jibanyan traverses the vast ocean in search of the elusive, Mythical Chocobar. He knows everything there is about the sea! But he's prone to seasickness. 「Let's set sail beyond the horizon, nyan!」

species.name: Jigajii-san Gen Hakuko
species.flavor: A Yo-kai that boasts「I'm great!」no matter what he does. It's best to just ignore him because dealing with him will only cause trouble.

species.name: Jikochuu Ri Shuku
species.flavor: A mouse that spent so much time hiding in a ditch that he came to believe he was the center of the world. Those inspirited by him become incredibly selfish.

species.name: Jimmy Kou So
species.flavor: When Dimmy inspirits someone, their presence becomes faint, and they become unnoticed by everyone. Dimmy uses this power for his work as a ninja.

species.name: Jinmenken Ro Shoku
species.flavor: A modern breed of a dog with a human face. He often surprises people who are drawn in by his cute back view. His dream is to be very popular with the ladies.

species.name: Jinrai Noruka
species.flavor: Noruka has obtained the power of thunder that never ceases to resound. In a fight with his twin brother Soruka, who doesn't get along well, a tremendous lightning bolt roars. His appearance is exactly like the god of thunder.

species.name: Jinta
species.flavor: The Shadowside of Jinta's body, which has been given a macho appearance to help show you how the human body works. You can see every single organ and muscle position in the body.

species.name: Jorogumo En Shou
species.flavor: A rain specialist. He likes highly feminine tactics such as poisoning cakes or using a kiss with deadly lipstick, but he is a real man.

species.name: Joushou Fuyunyan Sou Sou
species.flavor: Hovernyan, imbued with Cao Cao's power, became the highest ranking official, the chancellor. Even though he becomes great, he never forgets his guts and coolness, and aims for politics that is close to the people.

species.name: Junior
species.flavor: A Yo-kai with a cat-like appearance who can inflate his body like a balloon, going "poof", and freely change his appearance. Since he is little, he calls himself "Jī-tan".

species.name: Junkernaut
species.flavor: The minor grievances of various items sent to be scrapped have come together to form a rampaging Yo-kai, intent on wreaking havoc on the wasteful society that led to its creation.

species.name: Kabuking
species.flavor: The owner of Gera Gera Resort, he's also a superstar in the world of Kaibuki theater. He's friendly in person, but watch out for his stage persona. He's quite the fierce leading man.

species.name: Kabuto Muso Tou Gai
species.flavor: Only a Rhinoggin who has survived every battle and attained the power of the peerless is permitted to bear the name Rhinormous.

species.name: Kagaku Shaman
species.flavor: This Onryo is born from a scientist's inferiority complex, and he says and does things that mock those who have no power. He dexterously pinches bothered people with tweezers and tongs.

species.name: Kage Orochi Shuu Yu
species.flavor: Acting as Venoct's shadow, he has carried out dark assignments such as assassinations. Almost no one knows of his existence, as he disappears if anyone sees him.

species.name: Kagemaru U Kin
species.flavor: Cadin, who has become a fine warrior after mastering the Cicada Ninjutsu. He is working hard to prove that even the Cicada Ninjutsu can make someone strong if they master them.

species.name: Kageroo Kou So
species.flavor: A specialist in stealth who goes completely unnoticed by everyone due to his overwhelmingly faint presence. But, being unnoticed is actually a little lonely for him.

species.name: Kageroushi Tei Iku
species.flavor: An elder Yo-kai who specializes in disappearing like a mirage. He hides his presence and watches humans with a warm, amused smile. He is the brother of Illoo.

species.name: Kaimu Kou So
species.flavor: His presence is so incredibly faint that even you wouldn't even notice him standing right next to you. Because of that, he became exceptionally good at entertaining himself alone.

species.name: Kanaendesu
species.flavor: A Great Yo-kai that grants wishes and fills the world with desire. It used to be a small Vase Yo-kai that could only grant small wishes, but because it was abandoned by it's owner after granting his wish, it became obsessed with the delusion of "granting all desires".

species.name: Kanibouzu
species.flavor: A crab Yo-Kai that has lived through rough seas and has become the master of the seas. In order to gain more power, he attacks monks and absorbs their power. The monk's spirit has taken up residence in his back. At first, the monks fought constantly, but recently they have become good friends with the crab.

species.name: Kantaro
species.flavor: A discarded can was rolled around, and became a drifter Yo-kai. When someone kicks him, his hollow body makes a sad klink-klank sound.

species.name: KANTETSU Chou Shuu
species.flavor: A Yo-kai that keeps playing video games without sleeping a wink. The dark circles under his eyes are so intense they go beyond mere ill health and make anyone who sees him feel uneasy.

species.name: Kaoberos Ro Shoku
species.flavor: Since he has two creepy faces lined up side by side, nobody comes near him. He is an excellent guard dog and is even serving as a guard dog in Hell.

species.name: Kappa (Salaryman)
species.flavor: A kappa who's unbeatable when it comes to swimming ended up diving into a human company. Swiftly going with the flow of the current era has made him into a fine, relentless white-collar worker. He'll work hard for the sake of his family today, as always.

species.name: Kappa Kai Kakou Ton
species.flavor: The wicked form of Faux Kappa. He drags people who approach the river into it, drowns them, and then eats the souls he pulls out through their buttocks.

species.name: Karakara-san Bi Shi
species.flavor: A skeleton Yo-kai dressed in Gothic Lolita fashion. She normally acts quiet and refined, but if you insult her clothes, she flies into a rage and reveals her true nature.

species.name: Karakasa-majin Chou Kou
species.flavor: A Yo-kai who uses a Pallysol as a weapon. When the umbrella is open, it offers impenetrable defense. Closing the umbrella unleashes a desperate, all-out attack. A powerful Yo-kai that combines offense and defense.

species.name: Karakasa-obake Kai Ri Ten
species.flavor: The wicked form of Pallysol. The resentment of a discarded umbrella has come back to life, and he has ended up attacking every person reflected in his eye.

species.name: Karakasa-obake Ri Ten
species.flavor: A Yo-kai born from an umbrella that was used for many years. Remembering his owner's smiling face,he happily hops around on his single leg.

species.name: Karamizon Tou Haku
species.flavor: If Snaggly inspirits you, you'll become the kind of person who only causes trouble whenever they get involved. If a conversation just won't go smoothly, it might be because she is lurking nearby.

species.name: Karipakkun Saku Yuu
species.flavor: A Yo-kai that swallows up anything he wants to borrow and claims it as his own. If you become inspirited by him, you will never return anything you borrowed from someone.

species.name: Kashiwasheru
species.flavor: This is Sakurasheru's evolved form for Children's Day, originally known as 『Boy's Day』. With his plump, mochi-like appearance, he tempts people into buying kashiwa mochi. He's already planning what kind of 『mochi』 to get them to buy next.

species.name: Kat Kraydel
species.flavor: This string-pulling spirit controls the destiny of all humanity. It's up to you whether you go along with it or decide to fight fate!

species.name: Katanori-kozou Gaku Shin
species.flavor: He has a short temper and is always kicking people’s shoulders. Getting kicked doesn’t cause any injuries, but it leaves you with terrible shoulder stiffness.

species.name: Kayukayu Sou Hyou
species.flavor: If Scritchy is nearby, your whole body starts to itch. No matter how much you scratch, the itching won't stop, and your skin ends up all torn up.

species.name: Kazekamo Ryuu Ki
species.flavor: Anyone inspirited by this Yo-kai ends up feeling like they have a cold, but it's not a cold, they become stuck wondering whether they should take cold medicine or not.

species.name: Kelpacabana
species.flavor: The biggest star the world of seaweed has ever seen! He dances for screaming fans wherever he goes.

species.name: Kemamon Akai nan
species.flavor: A local mascot Yo-kai working hard to revitalize Harrisville. He continues his activities while grappling with the daily dilemmas of balancing his roles as a「character」and a「Yo-kai.」

species.name: Keukegen Hou Tou
species.flavor: A hairy Yo-kai that appears in damp, shady places. He doesn't possess much power, but he can sometimes make the person he inspirits a little hairier.

species.name: Keukegen Kai Hou Tou
species.flavor: The wicked form of Furgus. He awakened as a god of pestilence and began attracting dangerous evil energy. It is said that any illness summoned by Feargus can never be cured.

species.name: Kingmera
species.flavor: A regal Yo-kai who was once a legendary ninja. Supremely stealthy, he can steal any treasure.

species.name: Kinkaku Doujakudai
species.flavor: Gold medals, gold prizes, first place. If you're inspirited by Castelius I, you're sure to become number one at whatever you do. This is definitely what you should aim for.

species.name: Kintaronyan
species.flavor: A wild feline Yo-kai who carries a mighty axe, tears up the mountains and fights bears hand-to-hand! Even his clothing is cheekily wild!

species.name: Kiraigyo Ri Kaku
species.flavor: A Yo-kai who looks for people's bad qualities and quickly comes to dislike anything and everything. His hobby is hitting the things he dislikes with the harisen on his tail.

species.name: Kirakiraion
species.flavor: Blazion reincarnated as a cold Yo-kai with a shining, below-freezing mane and a cool personality. He analyzes battles calmly and instantly freezes enemies glisteningly.

species.name: Kirakoma Son Saku
species.flavor: Koma Star, the superstar Yo-kai loved throughout the Yo-kai World, has been imbued with the power of Sun Ce, the brave superstar of Wu. With the combined charms of both, Kirakoma Son Saku shines so brilliantly that it's almost impossible to look at him directly.

species.name: Kirin Sou Hi
species.flavor: A sacred Yo-kai that protects all life. The voice of Kyryn has the effect of purifying away evil energy, and in the Yo-kai World, it is distributed as a download on music sites.

species.name: Kiwinyan Chou Un
species.flavor: A cat Yo-kai made from 100% kiwi juice. His unique charm point is the fine hairs growing on the surface of his body. Thanks to this fuzz, he feels soft but is surprisingly well-protected.

species.name: Kizunameko Ben Shi
species.flavor: The tongue of Tongus has antiseptic properties, allowing her to heal any wound simply by licking it. It is said that she can mend not only physical injuries but also the bonds between people.

species.name: Kizunurse Ben Shi
species.flavor: Tongus became a nurse by making use of her talent for healing. She is like the idol of the hospital, and many people eagerly await Nurse Tongus’s licking treatment.

species.name: Koalanyan
species.flavor: Don't you just want to push his cute nose? Who would've thought it would make THAT happen?!

species.name: Kodomonohi Jibanyan
species.flavor: Clad in armor and a helmet, with a war fan in hand, Jibanyan looks a little brave as he celebrates Children's Day, originally known as 『Boy's Day』. 「This war fan is so cool, nyan! Everyone! To battle, nyan!」

species.name: Kodomonohi Komasan
species.flavor: Komasan crafted adorable carp streamers to celebrate Children's Day, originally known as 『Boy's Day』. 「These carp streamers are higher than the roof, zura! I... I can't reach them, zura!」

species.name: Kodomonohi Shishimaru
species.flavor: Lie-in dressed up in a heroic costume to celebrate Children's Day, originally known as 『Boy's Day』. Even today, he's taking a nap so he can grow up to be a fine samurai.

species.name: Koenra Shin Shi
species.flavor: A Yo-kai that can appear anywhere there's smoke, such as from incense. When a Smogling grows, she becomes an Smogmella, but more often than not, she disappears before she ever gets the chance.

species.name: Koma Knomads
species.flavor: Twin brothers hitchhiking across BBQ. Whoever picks these guys up will find themselves feeling very lucky.

species.name: Koma Star
species.flavor: With a glistening smile, this Yo-kai instills others with the confidence they need to speak in front of a crowd.

species.name: Komajiro
species.flavor: Komasan's younger twin. he looks for his runaway bro. But he can't find him anywhere, poor guy.

species.name: Komajiro
species.flavor: A frog living at a certain shrine who was crushed beneath a guardian lion-dog statue! 'I may have died suddenly, but I’ll keep on living mongeero!´ With guts like that, he was born again as a Yo-kai.

species.name: Komami Son Shoukou
species.flavor: Komami, who travels the fields of the Three Kingdoms, has been imbued with the power of Sun Shangxiang, known as the 「Bow-Waisted Princess」and a lover of martial arts. Borrowing Sun Shangxiang's strength to bring peace to battles, she dreams of creating a world filled with 「Likes.」

species.name: Komane
species.flavor: Komasan's travels made him grow up into a brave and dependable Yo-kai. He's strong too!

species.name: Komasan
species.flavor: The appearance of a dog that was kept at a shrine and pinned under a Komainu statue, then turned into a Yo-kai. Komasan's pee has a purifying effect, and can remove obstructing barriers.

species.name: Komasan A
species.flavor: Having soldiered on steadily, Komasan's finally reached Rank A, much to the delight of his little brother Komajiro.

species.name: Komasan B
species.flavor: Komasan in clad-orange suit that specializes in terror time activities. He seams to feel a little closer to the urbanites when wearing this suit.

species.name: Komashura
species.flavor: A legendary Komasan with the heart of a greater demon. He scorches his foes with infernal flame.

species.name: Komejii Kou Chuu
species.flavor: A very rare Hungramps whose body is made of rice. He is kind enough to let hungry people eat parts of his own body. Its flavor is said to be worthy of praise even among the finest premium rice.

species.name: Konbu-san Kan Kou
species.flavor: One of Wiglin's dance companions. He takes pride in believing that kombu is the finest seaweed of all, and he also sees Wiglin as a rival.

species.name: Kongaragal Tou Haku
species.flavor: A troublesome girl who complicates conversations with her annoying tone. Apparently, many friendships have fallen apart when she gets involved with people.

species.name: Kouten Shishi Enma
species.flavor: Serving as a strategist, Enma overturned countless unfavorable situations and gained unmatched martial prowess and tactical brilliance. His command, capable of bending even unstable battle conditions to his will, shines with overwhelming brilliance on the Three Kingdoms battlefield.

species.name: Kuchidake-onna Son Rohan
species.flavor: If you become inspirited by Chatalie, you will only talk without taking action. As a result, you will lose everyone's trust.

species.name: Kudan Kan Ro
species.flavor: A half-human, half-cow fortune-telling Yo-kai. He should have amazing powers of prophecy, but while he's still training, all he can currently predict are tomorrow's weather and pop quizzes.

species.name: Kuiijii Kou Chuu
species.flavor: A Yo-kai with such an insatiable appetite that he devours anything and everything in front of him. His mouth is practically like a black hole.

species.name: Kurogane Senbon Shuu Sou
species.flavor: He has a heavy, solid body made of iron. When a Ledballoon stands in your way, even a dump truck cannot move it.

species.name: Kusa-kui Otoko Kakou Ha
species.flavor: A Yo-kai with no ambitions and simply wants to live alongside the grass. Anyone inspirited by him becomes a weak, effeminate, herbivorous person.

species.name: Kusanagi Shuu Tai
species.flavor: A radiant holy swordsman wielding a divine sword bestowed upon him by the gods of heaven. Its sharp blade is said to cut down all evil and bring peace to the world.

species.name: Kuwaga Taishou Shou Kai
species.flavor: Only a Beetler who has overcome countless battles can become a Beetall. If you're struck by his massive body, you won't stand a chance.

species.name: Kuwano Bushi Shou Kai
species.flavor: A Yo-kai who fights with giant scissors and well-trained fists. He is still young and rough around the edges, but he is steadily building his strength by competing with Rhinoggin.

species.name: Kyubi
species.flavor: This Fox Yo-kai is one of the strongest out of every Yo-kai. He can easily make a volcano erupt.

species.name: Kyunshii
species.flavor: A hopping Yo-kai wanders around sadly, looking for the figure of the one she loves. When she becomes obsessed, her heart flutters at the sight of the person she loves, and she ends up dying of cuteness.

species.name: Kyuntarou Han Shou
species.flavor: An unbelievably cute dog Yo-kai that makes everyone around it swoon. He is aware of his own cuteness and cleverly uses those around him to his advantage. In reality, he is a little bit devious.

species.name: Lady Longnek
species.flavor: She could pass for human if she were able to resist the urge to stretch out her superlong neck.

species.name: Lafalotta
species.flavor: This Yo-kai sucks the laughter and fun out of a situation and keeps all the laughs for herself.

species.name: Lamedian
species.flavor: His jokes are the worst, inciting only involuntary guffaws at best. But he thinks he's hilarious. IS HE RITE, FOLKS?

species.name: Lava Lord
species.flavor: And in red, we have the only wrestler to rival Mad Mountain! It's the violent volcano himself- LAAAVA LOOOOOOORD!.

species.name: Lazy Sundae
species.flavor: This is the Yo-kai who makes dads stay in bed on Sundays instead playing with their kids!

species.name: Ledballoon
species.flavor: A dump truck couldn't move Ledballon's heavy body... which is bad news if it gets in your way.

species.name: Leggly
species.flavor: A pair of perfect limbs that gives whomever he Inspirits the loveliest legs in town!

species.name: Lie-In
species.flavor: A laid-back lion who wants to be a mighty warrior but tends to prioritize naptime above sword practice.

species.name: Lie-in Heart
species.flavor: Lie-in realized his full potential. He always waits for the perfect moment before striking.

species.name: Lionguist
species.flavor: Blazion's studies of the intricacies of diction and grammar have turned him into quite the polyglot.

species.name: Little Charrmer
species.flavor: Charms evil-doers while doling out her own fiery brand of justice. Loathes those who eat tempura with other fried food.

species.name: Lord Enma Awoken
species.flavor: Now in full command of his true powers, the might of the forces at Lord Enma's disposal are overwhelming.

species.name: Maboroushi Tei Iku
species.flavor: A Yo-kai skilled at manipulating illusions. With a caring personality, he uses illusions to explain even the most difficult things in a way that's easy to understand.

species.name: Machonyan
species.flavor: Machonyan's mask hides the scars he suffered during his time as a wrestler-in-training.

species.name: Mad Mountain
species.flavor: Hailing from the land of the frost, it's the wrestler with legs as thick as glaciers and a heart of ice: MAD MOUNTAIN!

species.name: Magasus Kouson San
species.flavor: When inspired by him, you get an irresistible urge to do things that will get you in trouble. If you have a friend who is always playing pranks, maybe this guy has inspirited them?

species.name: Maiden Ruin
species.flavor: As the guardian deity of an ancient ruin, this beautiful war goddess has spent an eternity in solitude. She will steal away anyone she takes a liking to, looking to fill the void in her heart.

species.name: Maison Dowasure Ryuu Shou
species.flavor: Wazzat, has grown from a hat to the size of a single room. The amount he can eat has increased, allowing him to devour all of a person's memories.

species.name: Mamemameinu
species.flavor: Although she has a gentle appearance, she is a "Bean Onryo" that can reduce the size of her opponents with beams emitted from her eyes. If you pamper her with her sparkling eyes, everyone will fall in love with her cuteness.

species.name: Masamune Shuu Tai
species.flavor: A Yo-kai swordsman who returned to the path of the sword after encountering a famous blade that stirred his samurai spirit. He uses his once-honed swordsmanship to punish villains.

species.name: Masshirocake
species.flavor: Whenever someone asks Petty-Cake about her Christmas plans, she puts on a tough act and says, 「Leave me alone!」, so her calendar ended up completely blank. She even did her makeup perfectly...

species.name: Maten Soranaki Boy
species.flavor: When Maten Soranaki grabbed the Satsuki doll's sword, for some reason his mind and body changed into that of a child! A super dynamic dark boy who mows down his enemies with full power!

species.name: Maten Soranaki Tou Taku
species.flavor: The power of Dong Zhuo, who was feared as a villainous tyrant, dwelled in Maten Soranaki, a knight of darkness born from feelings of resentment and hatred. With his mighty power of darkness, he plunges the turbulent world into further despair.

species.name: Matsu
species.flavor: A compassionate Progenitor, who possesses the power to heal those who are injured. It's said that all living creatures in town are healed completely, when beholding her dancing in mid-air with her fan.

species.name: McKraken
species.flavor: The leader of the group trying to take over the Yo-kai World. He can absorb energy through the holes of his hands. His full name is Squiddilius McKraken.

species.name: Mekabu-chan Hou Sanjou
species.flavor: Mekabu-chan, who is Sekisaku's lover and possesses the power of Abalone's three daughters, who excelled in martial arts. What about the love triangle between Wakame-Kun Kanojo and Konbu-san?

species.name: Merameraion Chou Hi
species.flavor: The king of beasts with a fiery mane. He is a passionate man who pours out his burning passion on those he possesses.

species.name: Mermaid Lady
species.flavor: Fubuki is an initiate Yo-kai Hero who transforms by merging with Mermaidyn. She fights as if she were swimming in the air with her beautiful singing voice.

species.name: Mermaidyn
species.flavor: Half girl, half fish, this Yo-kai has a lovely voice and is ever so curious about life on land.

species.name: Mermother
species.flavor: This special Yo-kai is the source of all life and claims to have given birth to the gods.

species.name: Michibiki Chou Shou
species.flavor: A cat Yo-kai made of 100% mandarin orange juice. He is more orange than cat in nature, and unlike ordinary cats, he seems to prefer resting on top of a kotatsu instead of snuggling underneath it.

species.name: Mikannyan Chou Un
species.flavor: A cat Yo-kai made of 100% mandarin orange juice. He is more orange than cat in nature, and unlike ordinary cats, he seems to prefer resting on top of a kotatsu instead of snuggling underneath it.

species.name: Mimikin
species.flavor: A store mannequin and very gifted mimic. Anyone he Inspirits starts doing impressions of others whenever possible.

species.name: Minimoto
species.flavor: A lightning fast, 1 inch tall Yo-kai. Even if you're lucky enough to spot him, he'll be gone again in an instant.

species.name: Minochi
species.flavor: When he's in love, he gets overly protective of his partner. He can make you a very jealous person.

species.name: Miradox
species.flavor: Triple the size and triple the power of Mirapo, Miradox makes it possible to travel through time as well as space.

species.name: Miss Teri
species.flavor: This Yo-kai loves a good mystery novel. Those Inspirited by it start seeing material for grand thrillers in their daily life.

species.name: Mister Sandmeh
species.flavor: His responsible attitude and respectable-salary- man's air of humility are so intense that others can't help but notice.

species.name: MitoMEN En Kyoudai
species.flavor: A trio of foreign-looking Yo-kai. Even when something inconvenient happens, they all agree on their stories, saying「Nuh-uh-uuhh!」and refuse to acknowledge the facts.

species.name: Mitsumata Mizuchi
species.flavor: A demon beast-like Yo-kai who runs wild in the Yo-kai World and uses his three heads as weapons. It seems that he used to go out to drink and loiter around every night, alongside his former buddy, Slimamander.

species.name: Mitsumata Nozuchi Ryuu You
species.flavor: A snake-like Yo-kai with three heads and large mouths. When faced with its body, protected by thick skin like an elephant's, even a famous sword tempered through a hundred battles is no better than a dull blade. The large eyeball inside one of his mouths is Slimamander's weakness.

species.name: Mochismo
species.flavor: He's cute most of the time, but when he's mad, his body cracks and his manly face pops out.

species.name: Modaka Ageha
species.flavor: A first-year student at Youma Idol Academy, proud of being the most dazzling in her class. No matter how down someone may feel, she can lift their spirits to the highest level. She aims to become the ultimate idol.

species.name: Momonyan
species.flavor: A cat Yo-kai born out of a peach. Raised by his grandparents, he is now on a quest to defeat Oni everywhere.

species.name: Monomannequin Ou San
species.flavor: It was once just an ordinary mannequin, but after imitating humans, it eventually became able to move. Anyone inspirited by him can't help but imitate other people all the time.

species.name: Moolinda
species.flavor: Her chosen method of torture is barraging her prisoners with questions about their love life. Truly awful stuff.

species.name: Morezou Kou Gai
species.flavor: Something always seems to be about to leak out of his trunk, leaving him constantly fidgeting in embarrassment. When he reaches his limit, he attacks by spraying a tremendous amount of water.

species.name: Motenusu Kaku Ka
species.flavor: Unlike Casanuva, this pitiful Yo-kai simply can't become popular no matter what he does. Anyone possessed by him will end up becoming just as unpopular.

species.name: Moximous K
species.flavor: He was a boy that loved Yo-kai so much that he became one himself. That love still spreads through hundreds of Yo-kai friends.

species.name: Mudazukai Chou Seihei
species.flavor: If you are inspirited by Spenp, you'll end up buying things you don't even want, and before long, all of your savings will be gone.

species.name: Mukamukade Sou Shin
species.flavor: A centipede Yo-kai that's always fuming. If you get inspirited by him, you'll feel incredibly irritated. Asking「Are you angry?」will only make things worse.

species.name: Muramasa Shuu Tai
species.flavor: A ghostly swordsman, possessed by an evil cursed sword, wanders in search of someone's blood. He sneaks up from behind and slashes silently.

species.name: Muridajou Jo Sei
species.flavor: He soars high into the sky, rejecting everything. What lies beyond Impass after overcoming it. That, no one knows yet.

species.name: Musha Kabuto Tou Gai
species.flavor: A rough and tumble rhinoceros beetle Yo-kai. He is constantly battling Beetler for the title of King of the Bug Yo-kai.

species.name: Mushiba-hakushaku Kaku Shi
species.flavor: A terrifying Yo-kai that dissolves and ruins the teeth of anyone he inspirits. He loves the faces of children crying out in pain from toothaches.

species.name: Nagabanana I Seki
species.flavor: This Yo-kai looks exactly like Babblong, but is made entirely of bananas and has absolutely no relation to Babblong. His problem is that insects are attracted to him.

species.name: Namahage Chou Ryou
species.flavor: A Yo-kai from the northern regions who goes from house to house asking, 'Any brats here?', frightening children. Lately, he’s been punishing kids who don’t follow traffic rules.

species.name: Namahage O
species.flavor: A Yo-kai HERO created when Mera transforms by merging with Snartle. With the two swords he carries, he boldly slashes into the enemy's chests.

species.name: Namigappa Kyou I
species.flavor: Kappa normally live in rivers, but this one is a rare surfing Kappa that rides the waves out at sea. He's also a bit of a flirt, trying to pick up girls while surfing.

species.name: Nankai Ka Juu
species.flavor: One of the Wicked Executives. He attempts to confuse others by using complex language. He possesses the most knowledge among all the Wicked

species.name: Narigama
species.flavor: Thankfully, you can tell when a good omen is coming by the sound of his hammer banging against the cauldron. The cauldron on his head is always hot. He uses it to cook rice and boil tea.

species.name: Necrosnartle
species.flavor: Necrosnartle a terrifying Yo-kai that continually exhales a damp breath. If you’re cleanly cut down by the swords in his hands, regardless of whether you’re a good kid or a bad kid, you’ll become a zombie in the blink of an eye…

species.name: Neighfarious
species.flavor: Shining mysteriously in the night sky, Neighfarious is a bit of an enigma. What kind of evil Yo-kai is he?

species.name: Neighthan
species.flavor: His habit of endlessly droning on has caused more than one person to lose the will to live.

species.name: Neko II Gold
species.flavor: After much contemplation over whether or not to give up the pacifier, he decided with a will of steel not to. That determination became his strength, leading he to evolve to the next stage.

species.name: Nekurama Tengu Hou Sei
species.flavor: A gloomy tengu who is always quietly reading books. However, there are many Yo-kai who find this atmosphere pleasant, and he has a hidden popularity.

species.name: Niku-kui Otoko Kakou Ha
species.flavor: His masculine instincts have exploded, transforming him into a true carnivorous guy. With his tanned body and smooth talk, he constantly hits on women.

species.name: Ningyo Son Shoukou
species.flavor: A Yo-kai with the upper body of a human and the lower body of a fish. She sings with a beautiful voice. Since she usually lives in the sea, she’s full of curiosity about people on land.

species.name: NITETESU
species.flavor: 「72 hours of gaming a day!」 That seems to be his motto; he's been playing non-stop for two full days without sleep. The coffee he drinks to stay awake has 10 times the usual caffeine!

species.name: No-Go Kart
species.flavor: Unsuspecting folks who accept a ride from this Yo-kai find themselves terribly lost because he has no sense of direction.

species.name: Nogappa Kyou I
species.flavor: I'm a kappa living by the water, and I love taking walks. When I get tired, I refresh myself by pouring water from the river onto a plate!

species.name: Norarikurari Ou In
species.flavor: He has a soft body and can smoothly dodge any amount of complaining thrown his way. If you become inspirited by Ben Tover, you become exceptionally good at making excuses.

species.name: Noroino Hanako Sai En
species.flavor: Toiletta after growing up and becoming a high school girl. She has become a dangerous girl who doesn't even listen seriously in class and thinks about curses all the time.

species.name: Note-kun
species.flavor: An evil spirit that turns the person whose name is written in the note into an unpleasant version of their former selves. He takes advantage of the darkness in the mind of the person who holds the notebook in his hand to increase the number of ghastly people.

species.name: Nul
species.flavor: You can't sense Nul even if you're really close to him. He's really good at entertaining himself.

species.name: Nummskull
species.flavor: Those Inspirited by Nummskull become totally hapless, and everything they do ends in failure.

species.name: Nunchucky
species.flavor: The successor to an ancient style of deadly ninjitsu. Quietly brings a graceful death to his enemies.

species.name: Obaku-sama Ri Shi
species.flavor: She possesses the power to enter dreams. With the help of Bakulia's power, she can even enter the dreams of someone she is interested and learn how that person truly feels.

species.name: Odenjin Ba Kin
species.flavor: The Oden Master of the Yo-kai Food Stall. He serves up flavorful oden while telling interesting stories, and it's said that if you grow up eating it, you'll become a fine, flavorful adult.

species.name: Odysseynyan
species.flavor: A cat that underwent a long and perilous journey to get back home. He was offered a great treasure but forgot to bring it back with him!

species.name: Ogama
