species.flavor: A toad Yo-kai who is the general of the Fleshy Souls in the Yo-kai world. He has survived hundreds of years and changed into a Yo-kai.

species.name: Oh Bah Gah!
species.flavor: A burger built by a rather excitable chef and who's prone to regular overreactions...

species.name: Oh Wheel
species.flavor: A car once belonging to a carefree driver, turned into a Yo-kai. Surprisingly, the now Yo-kai car drives very safely.

species.name: Oiran Suu Shi
species.flavor: She maintains her youth and beauty by draining the life force of her victims. She particularly prefers young and beautiful women and is always searching for her prey.

species.name: Okanenider You Shou
species.flavor: A brave hero who rose up to help the poor people of the world. However, his biggest obstacle is the cost of transportation, as he has no money to get there.

species.name: Ol' Fortune
species.flavor: Another old man with bags full of gifts. Unlike Ol' Saint Trick, all of his presents are good!

species.name: Omatsuri Rabby
species.flavor: A Snow Spect-hare who changed in a heart-shaped way at the arrival of the summer festival. This year, she seems to be deciding the best shaved ice flavor by eating various flavors of shaved ice.

species.name: Omatsuri Shishimaru
species.flavor: Lie-in continues training hard even in the summer. After getting tired and taking a quick nap, he was jolted awake by fireworks exploding and festival music. Today is a fun summer festival!

species.name: Omatsuri-hime
species.flavor: The fascinating Blizzaria experienced the enthusiasm of a festival and reincarnated as a festival Yo-kai. Inspirited humans will always be in a festive mood and will want to shout at any time and anywhere.

species.name: Omoidashin Jun Yuu
species.flavor: A deity who governs memories. By using a mysterious vacuum cleaner to suck out a person's memories, he can even bring back memories from their previous life.

species.name: Omoidasuppon Jun Yuu
species.flavor: If you put the softshell turtle you've been carrying on your back onto your head and pulls it off with a「Flush!」even things you have forgotten will come back to him. It'll clear away the mental fog, too.

species.name: Onarazumono You Hou
species.flavor: A Yo-kai that spreads farts whenever the opportunity arises. If you become inspirited by this guy, you won't be able to stop farting, so dash to a place where there are no people!

species.name: Onemu no Sei Chou Sen
species.flavor: If you are inspirited by her, you can play with Sandi in your dreams. It's so much fun that you become unable to wake up and continue sleeping forever.

species.name: Oni-kui Jo Sho
species.flavor: A terrifying Yo-kai said to feed on onis. He has a mouth large enough to swallow an oni whole, though it’s said to sometimes get a stomachache from it.

species.name: Onitaiji
species.flavor: Prohibited from eating oni for a diet, Demuncher reincarnated into a slim, handsome man. The spiral on his head changed to long hair and can be freely manipulated to eliminate oni.

species.name: Ookuwanokami Shou Kai
species.flavor: A stag beetle Yo-kai that has mastered the martial arts to the point of being worshipped as a god. Anyone inspirited by him gains strength comparable to that of a god of war.

species.name: Ootsunonokami Tou Gai
species.flavor: When the Yo-kai Rhinoggin attains even greater power and reaches the realm of the gods, it becomes the one and only being known as Hornaplenty.

species.name: Ooyama Sunao Kan You
species.flavor: Sandmeh, with his honest and straightforward personality, grew into a diligent office worker. His perfect, sincere bows make others instinctively bow down to him.

species.name: Orifalcon
species.flavor: "A bird yokai with a body made of a very hard metal called Orichalcum. It fights off intruders in the ruins, flying with its blade-like wings."

species.name: Originyan
species.flavor: A pure white, newborn cat Yo-kai. Now you get to take responsibility for turning it into a respectable Yo-kai!

species.name: Orochi
species.flavor: Orochi, travelling wherever the wind leads him, hoping to fight strong enemies he has not seen before. He goes all around the world, driving his bike that harbors the power of Orochi, but it seems that he actually just has no sense of direction...

species.name: Oshisshou Kaku To
species.flavor: A professional at creating awkward situations, even more so than Compunzer. His jokes are so old-fashioned that they only elicit awkward laughter. He himself thinks he's receiving high praise.

species.name: Osuberi-sama Kaku To
species.flavor: A Yo-kai who always creates an awkward atmosphere when trying to get a laugh. He has a strong heart and doesn't care even when his jokes fall flat, but everyone around him suffers.

species.name: Otomorashi Kan Chuu
species.flavor: He inspirits people who are listening to music through earphones and makes the music leak out loud for everyone around them to hear. It seems to be particularly prevalent on trains.

species.name: Otsubone-sama Son Rohan
species.flavor: If you become inspirited by Nagatha, you'll become a nagging, overly critical person who won't overlook even the slightest mistake.

species.name: Oyanome
species.flavor: An Onryo that attacks and swallows the families of its victims. The host will try to kill their family members as if their personalities have changed.

species.name: Pallysol
species.flavor: The sprightly spirit of a well-loved parasol. Just thinking about his old owner makes him jump up and down with joy.

species.name: Pandle
species.flavor: A careless Yo-kai who enters battle wearing only a loincloth...and a pan...on his head. Try not to take after him so much.

species.name: Pandora
species.flavor: In an attempt to overcome an enduring trauma, this Yo-kai opens every box she can get her hands on.

species.name: Peppillon
species.flavor: A butterfly Yo-kai with otherworldly wings. Breathing in its scales will boost your level of excitement to the max.

species.name: Percrushionists
species.flavor: There's so much brown on these brown-nosers, they're sticking together! Their obsequiousness is now somehow endearing...

species.name: Petty-Cake
species.flavor: This Yo-kai really wants to be left alone. Or does she? She keeps saying she wants to be left alone, but it seems like...

species.name: Pheasanyan
species.flavor: One of Momonyan's servants. He's the healer on the team, but he often forgets to perform this duty.

species.name: Pink Emperor
species.flavor: Captain Thunder, having achieved Emperor Mode after awakening to the Hose during his space adventures. However, having turned to the pink side of the Hose, his heart, body and even voice have been changed forever!

species.name: Pinkipoo
species.flavor: Known as the Aristocrat of Love, Pinkipoo uses his overpowering cuteness to win over new followers.

species.name: Pintocool
species.flavor: Suddenly, a Cornfused had a flash of inspiration, and turned into an ice cream Cornfused. When this guy is around, your head becomes clear and everything gets a bit cooler. I don't know if it's my imagination or not, but it seems to beat the heat...?

species.name: Pit Bull
species.flavor: He is a Alien who makes his living by killing his opponents. He also has a obsession with samurai, and he also has his own style of killing the weakest of the weak.

species.name: Platinos
species.flavor: This Oni has taken his training and self-improvement to the next level, and has now gone platinum.

species.name: Poo
species.flavor: She is the leader of the Inu Tokumeitai and Doleru's sister. She is small in stature, but she has brains the size of a galaxy and brings together a team of unique personalities.

species.name: Poppo Jibanyan
species.flavor: Jibanyan has become a train station master. He stands at attention on the platform, but in reality, he's just sleeping while standing up. Ironically, this habit became a talking point, and he gained fame as the "Sleeping Station Master."

species.name: Positibun
species.flavor: Influenced by a positive aura, Negatibuzz inadvertently reincarnated. Since then, he thinks very positively about everything, and his life has become brighter!

species.name: Pridon Shu Zen
species.flavor: A super-luxurious tempura rice bowl Yo-kai with both an exceptionally high price and an equally high sense of pride. Be careful, because if you get inspirited by Pride Shrimp, your pride will increase and you will incur the resentment of everyone.

species.name: Professor Plumage
species.flavor: Wherever there is a mystery to be solved, this Yo-kai follows. The mystery of the lost sock continues to vex him

species.name: Punching Baguette
species.flavor: After countless defeats, Buttered Blue has somehow become a hardened boxer. Brings out the hidden potential in the weak.

species.name: Puppynyan
species.flavor: One of Momonyan's servants. He is very loyal, and isn't just in it for the Doggy Dumplings.

species.name: Purachina-kaku Doujakudai
species.flavor: He is also known as「Hakkin-kaku.」A very rare yokai, if you are possessed by him, you will become a special being that transcends the concepts of winning and losing.

species.name: Puruphant Kou Gai
species.flavor: This Yo-kai will endure even the most painful situations, trembling all the while. If you are inspirited by him, you will become incredibly patient.

species.name: Putasockinit
species.flavor: Those inspirited by Putasockinit will always push things too far, upsetting all their friends.

species.name: Quagmira
species.flavor: Take care not to accidentally compliment this Yo-kai. It'll bind itself to you, making you unable to move.

species.name: Quaken
species.flavor: Every step Quaken takes shakes the place... and some of those vibrations can even move your heart. Awwwww!

species.name: Rai Oton Mou Kaku
species.flavor: No matter how lazy a kid is, they work briskly in front of Papa Bolt. He's terrifying when he unleashes his thunder.

species.name: Rai-chan
species.flavor: A mild-mannered thunder Yo-kai who works alongside his partner, Fuu-kun as the protégé of the Snake King. Normally, he looks like a child, but when he is angry, he strikes with crackling thunderbolts.

species.name: Raidenryu
species.flavor: "The great record-breaking Yokozuna Raidenryu that built the legend of professional Yo-kai sumo wrestling. His fighting form is like being struck by lightning. His opponents are blown away when he unleashes his skills."

species.name: Raizou Rai Dou
species.flavor: The furoshiki on his back, which stores tremendous lightning power, was a gift from his mother. He channels that power into his spear to unleash a devastating strike.

species.name: Rakutendou You Shou
species.flavor: He is incredibly optimistic about everything and don't worry about anything that happens. He is the kind of Yo-kai you'd like to be, but if he inspirits you, it's still a problem.

species.name: Rawry
species.flavor: He loves nothing more than revving the engine on his stolen bike and thoroughly annoying everyone.

species.name: Re-Q-Perate
species.flavor: This Yo-kai helps people recover when they're completely exhausted. Of course, there is a price to pay...

species.name: Red J Ryuubi
species.flavor: A devilish Yo-kai feared as the strongest of all Yo-kai, leaving behind various blood-soaked legends. Accompanied by his vicious minions, the「Army of Hell,」he goes from town to town, committing every imaginable atrocity. It is said that not even a single blade of grass remains where Rubeus J has passed.

species.name: Red Paws
species.flavor: A giant cat statue that is asleep most of the time. No one knows its true identity. Together with Swirlious Omai, it keeps a delicate but perilous balance in the Yo-kai world.

species.name: Reisenja Kaira
species.flavor: Having traveled across countless battlefields, Ananta's talents as a military commander have fully blossomed. Leading the charge at the front of all Yo-kai, his figure, repeatedly victorious in peerless battles, resembles that of a mythical serpent who brings wars to an end.

species.name: Reitou Onigiri
species.flavor: Flamurice finally reincarnated after being refrigerated for a long time! If he wants to return to his original form, heat him up in the range for some time at home! Can you easily reincarnate?

species.name: Retinado
species.flavor: A Yo-kai who enforces the speed limit on Mystery Way, where the cost of being caught speeding is your life! You'll know he's nearby when you see his camera flash.

species.name: Reversette
species.flavor: She resembles Reversa, but her reversed pattern is a rare sight. Her depression--not so rare.

species.name: Rhyth
species.flavor: The one female of the seaweed trio. Wiglin and Steppa both really like her, but she doesn't seem to notice.

species.name: Rifujin Ou I
species.flavor: A Yo-kai that constantly says unreasonable things and causes trouble for those around her Her selfish behavior toward her husband is especially outrageous, yet strangely enough, their marriage is still going well.

species.name: Righteous Zazel
species.flavor: The darkness within Zazel has turned to light, making him a kind of deity. Any Yo-kai who stray from the path of righteousness in his presence soon find themselves begging for forgiveness.

species.name: Rimokon-kakushi Chou En
species.flavor: A Yo-kai that enjoys hiding the TV remote just to watch people panic. It's this guy that's responsible for finding remotes in unexpected places.

species.name: Robo Ryuu-kun Ryuu Gu
species.flavor: This is Draggie's robot, who came from the future. He lost the path to evolving into Dragon Lord by gaining a body of steel, but he gained power that was comparable to him.

species.name: Robo-G Kou Chuu
species.flavor: A robot version of Hungramps that came from the future. Even after becoming a robot, he is constantly short on energy and always feels hungry.

species.name: Robogappa Kyou I
species.flavor: A robot version of Walkappa that came from the future. The plate on his head is now made of titanium, so it will never crack or break again.

species.name: Robokapp
species.flavor: A robotic Walkappa from the future. A ring of unbreakable titanium protects his cranium.

species.name: Robokoma Son Saku
species.flavor: A robot version of Komasan that came from the future. He's still not good with cities. His batteries often run out while he's wandering around.

species.name: Robomenken Ro Shoku
species.flavor: A robot version of Manjimutt that came from the future. At this point, it's doubtful whether he can even be called a Yo-kai anymore, and there's absolutely no trace left of his original human-faced appearance.

species.name: Robonyan SEA
species.flavor: A summer type Robonyan who has undergone extensive modifications to operate underwater. By rotating the propeller on his back, he swims at the same speed as a jet ski.

species.name: Rokuro Rocks
species.flavor: An Ancient Yo-kai HERO that transforms when Chiaki merges with Lady Longnek. Fight while disturbing the enemy with a supple beat.

species.name: Rokurokubi Chou Shunka
species.flavor: A Yo-kai with the ability to stretch her neck to great lengths. As long as she doesn't stretch her neck, no one realizes she is a Yo-kai, but she simply can't resist doing it anyway.

species.name: Rokurokubi Kai Chou Shunka
species.flavor: The wicked form of Lady Longnek. She uses her long, outstretched neck as a weapon, wrapping it around defenseless people and squeezing them, causing them to suffer.

species.name: Rollen
species.flavor: Everything he does is decided by a roll of his dice eyes. Their outcome changes his personality!

species.name: Rubynyan Chou Un
species.flavor: A cat Yo-kai whose entire body is made of rubies. He defeats his enemies with a body that shines like flickering flames.

species.name: Saikouchou Shou En
species.flavor: People possessed by him can bring out a level of peak performance unlike anything they have ever experienced before. A butterfly Yo-kai that everyone desires.

species.name: Sailornyan Chou Un
species.flavor: A marine-loving, girly cat Yo-kai who works on a ship. Her feminine charm is exceptionally high, making her the most popular among the crew.

species.name: Sakigakenosuke Kin Sen
species.flavor: A Yo-kai whose motto is to be the first to charge into any battlefield, living for reckless attacks. He fights naked, so he's always tanned.

species.name: Sakura no Jima Chou Kou
species.flavor: A sumo Yo-kai with explosive power on the level of a volcano. Mad Mountain is his eternal rival, and their head-to-head record stands at 99 wins and 99 losses.

species.name: Sakuranyan
species.flavor: Powered by a miraculous force, the fluttering cherry blossoms and Jibanyan have combined! With his mysterious, cherry-blossom-shaped paws, any cherry blossom, whether 20% bloom, 50% bloom, or 80% bloom, will be in full bloom, nyan!

species.name: Sakurasheru
species.flavor: It's spring time and Almi has transformed into a sakura mochi. His body emits a wonderful scent that makes people buy sakura mochi. However, this phenomenon only occurs during cherry blossom season.

species.name: Sandi
species.flavor: When Sandi inspirits you, the two of you will play in your dreams. It's too fun to ever wake up from.

species.name: Sandmeh
species.flavor: A simple, serene Yo-kai whose calming aura is so effective, he can get even Roughraff to chill out.

species.name: Sanshokudangomasan
species.flavor: Komasan went to see the cherry blossoms and became captivated by the three-colored dumplings. Carrying the giant, chewy, three-colored dumplings, he tore off bite-sized pieces to share with the other viewers.

species.name: Santaku Roushi Hi I
species.flavor: He gives you one of the best present, the ordinary present, or the worst present. If you ask for all of them, though, he simply leaves.

species.name: Sanzu no Inu Ro Shoku
species.flavor: An elite watchdog of Hell, born and raised there. He won't allow a single soul to escape from hell to the surface.

species.name: Sasurai no Billy
species.flavor: A pirate captain from the Yo-kai Age of Exploration. Enticed by Kanaendesu, he turned a small island into Karakuri Island, and keeps on digging there for the infinite treasures it brings forth. He doesn't realize that Kanaendesu was using him to find the Banbarastone.

species.name: Scarasol
species.flavor: He uses a Pallysol as a weapon, blocking attacks by opening him and then striking by jabbing him at opponents.

species.name: Sebastian Shokatsu Kin
species.flavor: A genuine Yo-kai butler dispatched by the Yokai Butler Association. His techniques are top-notch, but his pursuit of perfection sometimes leaves everyone stunned.

species.name: Sei Okan Shu Kuyuu
species.flavor: Sometimes strict, sometimes gentle, she embraces and cares for all Yo-kai. No matter what Yo-kai it is, they cannot raise their head before Mama Aura.

species.name: Seiryuu Ryuu Gu
species.flavor: A legendary divine beast. He governs the power of water and protects beautiful waterfalls and rivers. His power is said to surpass even that of Dragon Lord.

species.name: Semimaru U Kin
species.flavor: He's apparently a practitioner of a ninjutsu technique called Cicada Ninjutsu, which nobody has ever heard of. His actual abilities are nothing special, and his only real strength is his ability to run away.

species.name: Sgt. Burly
species.flavor: The much-loved boss of Burly's Beat Camp doesn't go easy on folks he trains. He's there to pump you up, after all!

species.name: Shamasol
species.flavor: Pallysol turned Wicked! The regrets of a discarded umbrella brought to life...

species.name: Sharekofujin Bi Shi
species.flavor: A fashion-obsessed Yo-kai with an outrageously flashy style. She inspirits people she likes and makes them adopt the same fashion sense.

species.name: Shellebrity
species.flavor: An energetic producer that is incredibly difficult to understand due to its excessive use of industry buzzwords.

species.name: Shidoromodoro Tou Ken
species.flavor: If this Yo-kai possesses you, you'll have trouble getting your words out, and even you won't understand what you're saying. He's especially dangerous when reading aloud.

species.name: Shikirunja Tei Gen
species.flavor: An elder snake Yo-kai who always wants to be in charge of everything. When he gives orders with his tail, which bears a commander's war fan, for some reason no one can bring themselves to disobey him.

species.name: Shin Obaa Shu Kuyuu
species.flavor: Her boundless kindness heals everything. No matter how evil a Yo-kai may be, when embraced by Auntie Heart, it regains they beautiful heart.

species.name: Shinigami Kamaitachi
species.flavor: Whirlweasel dresses up as a shinigami and participates in the Halloween festivities. His prized scythe, decorated extravagantly, can slice through anything at high speed. Even hard pumpkins are no problem for him.

species.name: Shinigamidori Chou Han
species.flavor: If you see a Skreek, you should run away immediately. They plunges the person they inspirits into the depths of despair and never returns.

species.name: Shippuu Soruka
species.flavor: Soruka has gained the power of a fierce wind that never stops blowing. During a fight with his twin brother, Noruka, who doesn't get along well with him, he creates a tremendous windstorm. His appearance is exactly like a wind god.

species.name: Shippuujinrai Norukasoruka
species.flavor: Noruka, who has gained the power of thunder, and Soruka, who has gained the power of wind, combined to create Shippuujinrai Norukasoruka. A roar of thunder and a violent storm rages, devastating everything around him.

species.name: Shirokabe Jo Sei
species.flavor: Long ago, he served as the wall of a magnificent castle, but after the family that defended it for a long time perished, he has now become a Yo-kai.

species.name: Shirokuma
species.flavor: A Yo-kai who continuously likes to inspirit human babies one after another, making them devilishly selfish. When his mother "Shirokumama" gets angry at him, he cries. But he lo~ves his Mama..

species.name: Shishi Enma
species.flavor: Lord Enma jumped into the world of the Three Kingdoms as a warrior. He soon learned the ability to watch the game calmly, but he never stopped growing stronger as he learned more on the battlefield.

species.name: Shishikoma Son Saku
species.flavor: Having wandered countless times, Komasan has become incredibly strong. Not only has his strength grown, but his heart has also matured, and he's no longer easily intimidated. A truly reliable Yo-kai.

species.name: Shiwaku-chan Suu Shi
species.flavor: She was beautiful in her youth, but now she's a wrinkled old woman. Resenting smooth, beautiful things, she gained the terrifying power to make anything become wrinkled.

species.name: Shogun King
species.flavor: The 'King of Big Bosses.' He has slain thousands of warriors in countless battles with his huge sword. Those lost souls follow him giving him the appearance of a true king of the dead.

species.name: Shourinjii
species.flavor: A Yo-kai who has trained for so long that martial arts has become a natural part of his daily life. Anyone inspirited by him cannot resist mimicking the main character of an action movie.

species.name: Shousei Fuyunyan S Sou Sou
species.flavor: With love, guts and moxie as his watchwords, he underwent further intense training and became a super shōsei S rank. It is said that his overflowing guts and spirit have become even hotter, but he himself doesn't really care.

species.name: Shousei Jibanyan Ryuubi
species.flavor: In a mysterious world, Jibanyan, who has become armored, has the power of Liu Bei, a hero who was active in ancient China. As a result of accumulating his virtues, he became a shōsei, and his motivation to unify the world seems to have increased.

species.name: Shousei Komasan Son Saku
species.flavor: The will of the courageous "Little Overlord" Sun Ce gave the kind-hearted Komasan more confidence and strength, powering him up as a shōsei star. With his inherent curiosity, he runs around the vast battlefield to the west and east.

species.name: Shousei Kuro no Omen Ka Ku
Showbonyan
species.flavor: This top of the line entertainment robot has been fitted out with all the latest gadgets.

species.name: Shrook
species.flavor: Shrook will make you bad at whatever you're usually good at. He can make a master into a novice pretty quickly.

species.name: Shurakoma Den Tan
species.flavor: Before the era of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, Tian Dan was a military commander who saved the Qi nation from crisis with his ingenuity. That power dwells in Komashura, which is said to have the heart of Shura.

species.name: Shurikenny
species.flavor: The successor to an ancient style of deadly ninjitsu. Quietly brings a graceful death to his enemies.

species.name: Shuugen Orochi
species.flavor: Venoct wears a blue kamishimo. He arrived dressed in formal attire befitting a celebratory party. 「What a joyous occasion. A bit of festive revelry isn't so bad once in a while...」

species.name: Silver Lining
species.flavor: A natural born leader with impressive musculature and an unwavering sense of justice. Protects people (and sushi) from the sky.

species.name: Sir Nyansalot
species.flavor: An armored cat Yo-kai who once defended a king, and he will put his life on the line for his master.

species.name: Siro
species.flavor: Siro brings out the best in those he inspirits. They become shining lights for the future.

species.name: Skelebella
species.flavor: She's so confident in the unparalled beauty of her bones that she doesn't even need her skin.

species.name: Skulk
species.flavor: I'm sure you know the feeling, when you're heading down a dark and lonely road, all by yourself. All of a sudden, you just know, from the bottom of your soul...don't turn around!

species.name: Sky Snaker
species.flavor: Chiaki Hebiyama transforms into a rockin' Yo-kai Hero, dodging attacks with his unlikely softness and dispatching his enemies with beatific sonic blows.

species.name: Slacka-slash
species.flavor: More dangerous than he looks, Slacka-slash can beat his foes with only a single slice.

species.name: Slimamander
species.flavor: A huge, snakelike Yo-kai with three bigmouthed heads and skin thicker than an elephant's. Aim for the eye in its mouth!

species.name: Slitheref
species.flavor: When a battle starts, Slitheref will appear out of nowhere and make sure the fight stays fair and square.

species.name: Sly
species.flavor: The appearance of Slimamander, the giant three-headed serpent, as a Lightside. It appears this demon beast-like Yo-kai looks up to active humanoid types.

species.name: Smashibull
species.flavor: He's completed his training as a fortune- teller and now knows exactly what's going to happen next.

species.name: Smogling
species.flavor: A wispy spirit who appears in smoky places but often blows away before she develops into something more substantial.

species.name: Smogmella
species.flavor: Her vaporous nature means she can take on any form she chooses, but this shape is by far her current favorite.

species.name: Snidewinder
species.flavor: Putasockinit has taken a turn for the malicious! Now he spouts nothing but venom and vitriol.

species.name: Snow Rabby Ben Shi
species.flavor: Snow Spect-hare was born when a snow rabbit possessed the mind of a child, has been imbued with the power of Lady Bian, the modest wife of Cao Cao. With a gentle heart that cherishes things dearly, she continues to wear her favorite costumes and hair accessories.

species.name: Sonic Bam
species.flavor: With a new mastery over super sonic kung-fu, this Yo-kai can fell his opponents before they've even seen him!

species.name: Sorrypus
species.flavor: Whenever you apologize to someone for something that wasn't your fault, this thing is probably inspiriting you. A simple life lesson: Don't blame yourself for everything! It's a painful feeling!

species.name: Soureisenja Kaira
species.flavor: Ananta, who has overcome countless deadly battles as a military commander, has gained authority and wisdom that overwhelms others. With his freely manipulable Blue Flame and his powerful Snake King Sword, he has an absolute presence on any battlefield.

species.name: Speedemountain
species.flavor: Speed first, safety second! This Yo-kai is to blame if you have a sudden shift in your mood!

species.name: Sproink
species.flavor: This middle-aged Yo-kai loves hot baths so much that he sneaks into hot springs after hours. He turns red and snorts fire from his nose when he's been soaking too long.

species.name: Squandeer
species.flavor: This Yo-kai is constantly trying to reclaim his lost childhood, spending all of his money on whatever catches his fancy.

species.name: Starry Noko
species.flavor: Wubwubwubwub! We have travelled here from far across the stars! We sense you have grown bored of your dull terrestrial Noko!

species.name: Steppa
species.flavor: Steppa is one of Wiglin's rivals. He believes that kombu is the best kind of seaweed... if there even is such a thing.

species.name: Sternyan
species.flavor: The normally lazy Jibanyan has had a change of heart. Now everything is SERIOUS! Even his hair roots are serious!

species.name: Summer Rabby
species.flavor: In love with the summer sea, Snow Spect-hare reincarnated. If you luckily meet her on the beach during the summer of the year, it seems something wonderful and memorable will happen.

species.name: Summer Shakurero
species.flavor: A rising star of the Yo-kai pro wrestling world is taking on the beach volleyball tournament, representing his team! His brutal spikes bursts the ball with a single hit.

species.name: Summer the Shark
species.flavor: The Jawsome Kid, a popular wrestler making waves in the Yo-kai World, is entering the summer beach volleyball tournament! He overwhelms his rivals one after another with spectacular high-impact moves honed from pro wrestling!

species.name: Sunao Kan You
species.flavor: This Yo-kai has a very honest personality. Even the notorious「Roughraff」apparently became obedient, turning into a refined young gentleman with silky-smooth hair.

species.name: Sunesnake Tei Gen
species.flavor: A snake Yo-kai that's always sulking. If you get inspirited by him, you'll become a petty person who sulks over even the slightest unpleasantness.

species.name: Sunk'nsoul
species.flavor: Breathing this guy's gas makes it feel like you're sinking to the bottom of a river. His only weakness is fresh air!

species.name: Supyo
species.flavor: Whereas most kappas stick to rivers, this one likes to surf... and pick up girls while he's at it.

species.name: Suspicioni
species.flavor: An Oni who doubts everything. He hangs out with his fellow Oni but doesn't trust them at all.

species.name: Swelterrier
species.flavor: His fiery heart and body always make him feel too hot. Being near him is like being near a space heater.

species.name: T-Dine
species.flavor: Mataro's true hero form, when possessed by Tidas and using GAI Energy! The heart of justice, as hot as the sun, resides firmly in his chest.

species.name: Tabigappa Kyou I
species.flavor: A kappa who travels from place to place, honing his swordsmanship. With his prized blade made of water, he slices through anything with effortless, clean cuts.

species.name: Taigong Wang
species.flavor: A long time ago, he was a Taoist from Mount Kunlun who led the nation of Zhou. Cheerful and easygoing, he seems inscrutable at first glance, but he possesses a strong will to fulfill his mission. He’s a passionate fishing enthusiast, though apparently not very skilled at it.

species.name: Taishi Gensui Nata
species.flavor: This is the powered-up version of Nezha, who can freely control the Hermit's weapon known as Pao Pei. He can now use more Pao Pei at a time, making him even stronger, but his childlike nature has also increased, and he innocently swings them around.

species.name: Tamamo
species.flavor: In a rural town, a fearsome fox spirit collects the souls of living humans. Normally, they look very much like humans and work without any regard for their appearance. Who knows? You might be their next victim...

species.name: Tanbo
species.flavor: A Yo-kai who is always first to the battle! With nothing to slow him down, he shows up early and always has a nice tan.

species.name: Tararin Sai Bou
species.flavor: A nosebleed Yo-kai, just as his appearance suggests. When inspirited by him, not only nosebleeds but also paint, ink, udon broth, and all sorts of other things will start to drip.

species.name: Tengu Ba Shoku
species.flavor: A great Tengu who controls an extraordinary power over the wind. It seems that the power of the sacred treasure fan he holds in his hand is greater than his own abilities.

species.name: Tengu the Nine
species.flavor: A Yo-Kai HERO that transforms by uniting. It creates a dynamic wind with quick and splendid movements.

species.name: Tenguriginal
species.flavor: A flying Classic Yo-kai who'd love nothing better than to cut off his rival Tengu's big nose.

species.name: Terranog
species.flavor: A super-civilized Hero who transforms, thanks to the AT-accelerator mode of the Majin Watch. With his boundless energy, he can face any enemy.

species.name: TETSUYA Chou Shuu
species.flavor: A true night-owl Yo-kai that keeps playing all night, no matter how tired he gets. If you have a friend who brags about staying up all night, they might be inspirited by Wydeawake.

species.name: The Ghoulfather
species.flavor: As head of the mafia in the Yo-kai World, the Ghoulfather was banished into space by Enma the Ancient. After a miraculous meeting with an alien spaceship, he has returned to seek his vengeance.

species.name: The Jawsome Kid
species.flavor: A popular pro wrestler who takes up hero work during his downtime. He seems to have a famous father...

species.name: Thornyan
species.flavor: Jibanyan's proud of his new spiky body. Just don't walk behind him while you're barefoot.

species.name: Thurston
species.flavor: A demon lord once bested by humans. Now his strict training regimen keeps him on a steady diet of healthy foods and drinks.

species.name: Tidynator
species.flavor: A cutting edge Robot Yo-kai who was born to protect the safety of the world's people. From life-saving to plumbing issues, he will support your livelihood 24 hours a day.

species.name: Todomeki Kakou En
species.flavor: An oni with many eyes all over his body. Apparently, only one of those eyes is connected to his heart, and he can only be defeated by shooting that particular eye with an arrow.

species.name: Togenyan Chou Un
species.flavor: Jibanyan's attack power has increased thanks to his signature spiky body. After Thornyan finishes fighting, the surrounding area becomes covered in spikes, making it far too dangerous to go barefoot.

species.name: Tohohogisu Chou Han
species.flavor: A bird Yo-kai with a gloomy complexion. Those inspirited by her can't help but say,「Boohoo,」and end up making a series of embarrassing mistakes.

species.name: Toiletta
species.flavor: Toiletta really wants to make new friends, but she's too shy to leave the bathroom.

species.name: Tojikoumori So Ju
species.flavor: Hidabat stayed inside his house for so long that he eventually fused with it. Having become so completely one with his home, it's now impossible for him to leave.

species.name: Tomnyan
species.flavor: Torn from a comfortable life with his owner Emily when he was run over... Hang on, this seems awfully familiar!

species.name: Tomnyan S
species.flavor: Tomnyan continues to challenge BBQ crosswalk convoys. His heart gave in, and steeled itself, it resulted in him turning into an S rank.

species.name: Tomorrow Gal
species.flavor: This Yo-kai perks you up by reminding you that even if today is terrible, there's always tomorrow!

species.name: Too-Much-To-Take
species.flavor: Mishearing is no longer a problem for this Yo-kai, but now it can't stop hearing unsolicited rumors about itself.

species.name: Toosenbon Shuu Sou
species.flavor: A strange Yo-kai who is passionately devoted to blocking the path of anyone who walks by. What motivates him is a mystery.

species.name: Topanyan Chou Un
species.flavor: A cat Yo-kai whose entire body is made of topaz. Anyone who can become friends with Topanyan is extremely lucky.

species.name: Torajirou Son Ken
species.flavor: While continuing his journey in search of Komasan, he grew stronger and more resilient. The power of the fierce tiger awakens, and the tiger's fighting spirit surges forth.

species.name: Tosan
species.flavor: A member of the Doggy Special Task Force, she has more girly spirit than anyone else, despite her muscular body. Never hug her, for she will never let go.

species.name: Toushirozame Ko Shaji
species.flavor: Anyone possessed by Shrook will become hopelessly bad at things they're normally good at. Even someone regarded as a master craftsman becomes as incompetent as an amateur.

species.name: Toushou Douketsu
species.flavor: In order to help his master, Voidera became a Bushou full of fighting spirit. At times, he uses his ingenuity to disturb the world of war. Seeing his back, countless soldiers aspire to become a Bushou commander like him.

species.name: Tsuragawari To Shi
species.flavor: When she inspirits someone, their face changes, causing everyone to think「Have you always looked like that?」every time they meet someone. She often inspirits women.

species.name: Tsuraretarou-maru Kan Nei
species.flavor: The guardian of Catfish Pond, he is the master of the pond. He gets extremely angry at people who disturb the pond, he can lose all sense of restraint, but the fish hold him in high regard because of his manly personality. At a single call from SV Snaggerjag, the big fish of the pond immediately come gathering.

species.name: Tut 'n' K'mon
species.flavor: His staff work flat-out to make sure this impatient Yo-kai is never kept waiting, not even for a second.

species.name: Twirly Pie
species.flavor: This Yo-kai always seems to be around when you've taken a hit to the noggin. It'll join you in twirling around uncontrollably.

species.name: Ultimate Robonyan
species.flavor: Incorporating all fields of knowledge, this newer and slimmer Robonyan is more powerful than ever.

species.name: Uma Ginnan
species.flavor: A cheerful Neighfarious that sports large ginkgo leaves on his back. Where have his wings gone? The mystery of this enigmatic Neighfarious only deepens as autumn arrives.

species.name: Uma Kouson San
species.flavor: A horse Yo-kai that glows mysteriously in the night sky. Neighfarious himself is so incredibly rare that no one knows what kind of Yo-kai he is, or even what the「farious」part refers to.

species.name: Umi-bouzu Seki Heki
species.flavor: A Yo-kai with a heart as vast as the ocean. And that's no surprise. In fact, he's an embodiment of the sea, and it wouldn't be an exaggeration to say that he is the ocean itself.

species.name: Undy
species.flavor: Having abandoned the pan, Undy is pretty much bare to the world. That aside, you won't ever see him wince or bruise.

species.name: Ungai Sanmenkyo Dei Kou
species.flavor: Mirapo has split into three faces, tripling his yokai power. He can now transcend not only space, but time itself. He is currently studying time paradoxes.

species.name: Ungaikyo
species.flavor: He is a mirror from the future world. He is a veteran of the Ungai Network, a union that warps people and things. He considers the Yo-kai Drone as his rival.

species.name: Ungaikyou Dei Kou
species.flavor: An ancient mirror of noble lineage that became a Yo-kai after a spirit took up residence within it. He possesses the mysterious ability to connect mirrors with the space within them. He polishes and maintains his mirror 3 times a day.

species.name: Unikirin
species.flavor: A legendary creature with a horn that countless figures throughout history have tried to steal.

species.name: Unkeen
species.flavor: A wicked boss who wields great power, he believes it's his duty to destroy all that he sees".

species.name: Unshelltered
species.flavor: This Yo-kai helps those he Inspirits to grow out of their shell...but his own shell is all empty!

species.name: Untidy
species.flavor: A Wicked boss who is always all in. No Yo-kai can match Untidy for pure power.

species.name: Urakyunta Han Shou
species.flavor: A terrible Yo-kai that seems to embody every last one of Pinkipoo's devious traits. Anyone he inspirits becomes completely wicked, letting their scheming nature run wild.

species.name: Urayamashirou Chou In
species.flavor: A Yo-kai that envies even the smallest things other people have. But he makes no effort to obtain those things himself.

species.name: Urayameshi Shu Zen
species.flavor: A bento box Yo-kai made only of rice, who always looks enviously at everyone else's lunches. If you are inspirited by him, you will immediately become envious of others.

species.name: Uribou
species.flavor: Although he is the guardian of the mountains and the king of boars, he enjoys running through the mountains with the animals more than anything. For that reason, he usually hides his noble social status.

species.name: Urnaconda
species.flavor: That's no regular pot- there's a huge snake inside! Some say this inspired the creation of the jack-in-the-box.

species.name: USAcake
species.flavor: Usapyon is baking homemade cakes to celebrate the first anniversary. He couldn't settle for just the mini cakes, so he turned himself into a cake too! 「The best cake is me, dani!」

species.name: Usapyon
species.flavor: This 'Merican Yo-kai dreams of becoming a space cowboy. Anger him and he'll go into Invader Mode.

species.name: Usapyon B
species.flavor: Usapyon in a special suit for Terror Time! Features a secret function that allows him to "use the Hose" and enter Emperor Mode.

species.name: Ushi Jibanyan
species.flavor: Longing for the easygoing life of a cow, Jibanyan has fully transformed into one.「A leisurely, slow-paced life... Moo~ I don't think I can ever go back, nyan~」

species.name: Verygoodsir
species.flavor: An excellent but fussy manservant officially certified by the Yo-kai Council of Applied Butlering.

species.name: Wakame ☆ Star Kan Saku
species.flavor: Wiglin has risen to become the top dancer of the seaweed world. Through the power of his dance alone, he fills live concert venues all across Japan with fans.

species.name: Wakame-kun Kan Saku
species.flavor: Wiglin is a seaweed Yo-kai who dances gracefully in an effort to spread awareness of「Wiggling Wave,」the famous local dance from his hometown. He's very healthy thanks to the power of seaweed.

species.name: Wakaretaro
species.flavor: ”Shmoopie lost all his love and reincarnated. The heart he carries is now a broken heart. Anyone inspirited by him will feel extremely heartbroken.

species.name: Walkappa
species.flavor: Most kappas stay in the water, but this one likes to walk around. He pours water on his head to make up for this.

species.name: Walldin
species.flavor: 'Formerly a sturdy castle wall, the fall of the family he once protected turned him into a Yo-kai.

species.name: Wang Guiren
species.flavor: A biwa Yo-kai and the sister-in-law of Da Ji. She's always in her own world, listening to the tunes that run through her head. Because of that, she doesn't listen to people, and she often gets into fights with Hu Ximei, who is always with her.

species.name: Warautsubo Hou Ki
species.flavor: An eel-like Yo-kai that's always laughing, no matter what he finds so funny. He bursts into laughter at the slightest thing that tickles its funny bone. Maybe his sense of humor is just a little strange?

species.name: Warunyan Chou Un
species.flavor: This is Jibanyan in his rebellious, delinquent form. With his impressive pompadour and homemade tokko uniform, he has a style that really evokes a distinctly old-school style.

species.name: Wasurenbou Ryuu Shou
species.flavor: He fits perfectly into a person's head and devours their memories. Sometimes, he can even make them forget unpleasant things.

species.name: Whirlweasel
species.flavor: This Yo-kai likes to ride whirlwinds, cutting everything in its path with its huge scythe. Carries spare plasters.

species.name: Whisped Cream
species.flavor: An evil Yo-kai who saps the strength of other Yo-kai to increase its size. Its fluffy body is something of a trademark. It can split into smaller creamy pieces an infinite number of times.

species.name: Whisper
species.flavor: A self-proclaimed Elite Yo-kai Butler who once served a human master. Since then, he has returned to the Yo-kai World and was left in charge of all Yo-kai Watch-related issues by the Great King Enma.

species.name: Wondernyan Chou Un
species.flavor: A wondrous cat Yo-kai who has traveled across many continents and embarked on numerous grand adventures. He is searching for his next adventure, accompanied by his beloved bandana and sword.

species.name: Yadokoumori So Ju
species.flavor: A rare Abodabat that shuts itself away in a lodging house instead of his own house. Once a year, the rare sight of him changing houses can be witnessed.

species.name: Yakkai Kaku Wai
species.flavor: One of the Wicked Executives. A Yo-kai who finds joy in being a nuisance. He's the most spiteful of all the Wicked.

species.name: Yamatan Shikoutei
species.flavor: A Yo-kai formed by the fusion of eight dragons. Each dragon’s personality remains, and they switch rapidly from one personality to another. If you’re inspirited by him, people might think you’re an unreliable, two-faced person who talks out of both sides of their mouth.

species.name: Yametaishi Sou Shoku
species.flavor: A monk who gets bored with everything almost immediately. He has magnificent eyebrows and a long beard, but rumor has it they're only that way because he's too lazy to bother trimming them.

species.name: Yami Kagami Dei Kou
species.flavor: A Yo-kai that stores the power of darkness within the endless space that unfolds within the mirrors. He lends that power to evil Yo-kai with interest, gradually accumulating his own strength.

species.name: Yami Kyuubi Jun Iku
species.flavor: Kyubi, who was captivated by the power of darkness and stained by it. Whether or not he wish for a day when all hope is trampled upon and the world is filled with despair.

species.name: Yang Jian
species.flavor: A Taoist priest of Mount Kunlun, the same as Taigong Wang. He has the ability to become a hermit, but he is an oddball who continues to call himself a Taoist. He specializes in the art of change, and is said to be able to manipulate 72 different techniques. His overconfidence is a flaw.

species.name: Yao Bikuni Son Shoukou
species.flavor: Sun Shangxiang, who fell in love with the hero Liu Bei, who became an emperor in ancient China. Had her power reside within Mermadonna, the legendary immortal said to gain eternal youth by being loved.

species.name: Yellskitchen
species.flavor: This former Yo-kai chef takes the preparation of his ingredients very seriously. Particularly when it comes to using his knife and cleaver to properly slice the meat.

species.name: Yo-kaiju
species.flavor: Standing at 82 meters tall, and weighing in at 165 tons, those three little turtles sure do seem to have gone through a bit of a growth spurt. What's in the water out there?!

species.name: Yoganalisten
species.flavor: This Yo-kai has mastered all yoga poses without help from anyone else. It's hard to argue with this yogi!

species.name: Yoink
species.flavor: A Yo-kai who says he's borrowing people's stuff but actually just swallows it and never gives it back.

species.name: Yokodori Jo Ei
species.flavor: Anyone who is stared at by Peckpocket becomes consumed by the desire to possess other people's things, becoming incredibly greedy.

species.name: Yomi Tengu Hou Sei
species.flavor: A Yo-kai that came from the underworld, but became quiet after becoming fascinated with books from the human world. When he gets too noisy, he gets angry and unleashes his original terrifying power.

species.name: Yoodooit
species.flavor: A wise old man who never lifts a finger if he can help it and always gets others to do his dirty work.

species.name: Yoroi-san Sou Jin
species.flavor: He lives each day with all his heart, dreaming of the day he'll be reunited with the other half of his helmet.

species.name: Yotsume Chou Shou
species.flavor: This yokai has four eyes that can read a person's「date of birth,」「favorite food,」「name」and「soulmate.」She can't read what's in someone's heart, though.

species.name: Zappary
species.flavor: His mother made him a nice knapsack in which he stores the mighty powers of thunder and lightning.

species.name: Zashiki-warashi
species.flavor: A handsome Zashiki-warashi who used to watch over people's houses as a guardian spirit. No idea what happened with that whole thing. Now he pursues his own beauty, and keeps on looking in the mirror day in and day out.

species.name: Zashiki-warashi Chou Ro
species.flavor: A mischievous child Yo-kai that lives quietly in old houses and storehouses. He brings a small amount of happiness to the house he takes up residence in.

species.name: Zashiki-warashi Kai Chou Ro
species.flavor: The wicked form of Gnomey. Misfortune continues to befall the house he settles in, and eventually even the family living there falls apart.

species.name: Zashiki-warashin Chou Ro
species.flavor: The deity of the Gnomey world. It is said that by enshrining just one strand of High Gnomey's hair, the household is guaranteed happiness for generations to come.

species.name: Zazel
species.flavor: Zazel is a top Yo-kai politician. He was turned against humans by the previous Lord Enma, his old master.

species.name: Zekkouchou Shou En
species.flavor: This butterfly Yo-kai possesses the wonderful ability to put anyone he possesses into peak condition. He is often mistaken for Enefly.

species.name: ZEKKOUCHOU Shou En
species.flavor: The people possessed by him end up breaking off their friendships with their best friends. A butterfly Yo-kai with a terrifying ability. He is often mistaken for Enerfly.

species.name: Zense and Raise
species.flavor: Raise's partner, the grudge of a couple of comic relief performers. He has a knack for reading his opponents' past quirks, and plays with their moves in sync with his own, as well as delivering sharp comebacks.

species.name: Zest-a-Minute
species.flavor: Her indecisive behavior might fit the bittersweet nature of youth, but her attitude only serves to sour the situation.

species.name: Zetsu-ojii Mou Kaku
species.flavor: He possesses absolute power, so much so that even his father fears him. His「Table Flip」technique, which can turn everything upside down, is extremely famous.

species.name: Zhou Wang
species.flavor: He was once the king of the Yin Dynasty. It is said that, bewitched by Da Ji, he lost sight of everything around him and became a tyrant. However, he was born with the pride of royalty, and was a wise, brave, and prudent ruler.

species.name: Zip Unlock
species.flavor: This Yo-kai unfastens zippers when you're not looking! That's never going to end well...

species.name: Zorome Daimyoujin Kai Etsu
species.flavor: If you're possessed by him, you'll end up getting caught up in all sorts of strange fates. Whether those things turn out to be good or bad, even Dubbles doesn't know.

species.name: Zouo Ri Kaku
species.flavor: He holds grudges over the smallest things and strikes from behind. The sight of Rageon standing by your bedside with a hatchet in hand is terror itself.

species.name: Zukyukyunta Han Shou
species.flavor: Thanks to his irresistible cuteness, he grew up receiving all kinds of love, earning him the title of Aristocrat of Love. He can charm anyone and make them act like his servant.

species.name: Zuruzuru-zuru Ryuu Ki
species.flavor: A crane Yo-kai with an unbelievably runny nose that just won't stop dripping. His biggest problem is that the snot is too heavy for him to fly.
